- name: int_asana__project_health_indicators
      description: Project-level health indicators derived from Asana projects and tasks with validated scores, percentages, and risk/forecast labels
      grain: One row per project_id (validated records only)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__project (project_id, project_name, created_at, due_date, owner_user_id, current_status, team_id)
      - staging.stg_asana__task (task_id, created_at, completed_at, is_completed, assignee_user_id)
      - staging.stg_asana__project_task (project_id, task_id)
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics (task_id, task_status_category, performance_grade, urgency_score, health_score, complexity_score, days_open, response_time_days, delay_days)
      business_logic: '1) Project and task filters: - project_base: projects where project_name and created_at are not null. - task_base: tasks where created_at is not null. - project_task_relation: all project-task links. - task_performance: all task performance metrics. 2) Project_task_stats (one row per project): - Left join p→ptr on project_id, then to t on task_id, then to tp on task_id. - Distinct task counts by project: • total_tasks: all linked tasks. • completed_tasks: tasks with is_completed = true. • active_tasks: tasks with is_completed = false. • assigned_tasks: tasks with non-null assignee_user_id. • unassigned_tasks: tasks with is_completed = false and null assignee_user_id. - Risk counts (distinct tasks): overdue (status_category=''overdue''), poor performance (grade=''poor''), high urgency (urgency_score ≥ 4), delayed (delay_days > 0). - Quality: • quality_tasks: performance_grade in {excellent, good}. • Averages: health_score, complexity_score (NULLs ignored). - Time metrics: • avg_completion_time_days: avg days_open over completed tasks; NULL if none. • avg_response_time_days: avg response_time_days; NULLs ignored. • max_task_age_days: max days_open; NULL if none. • avg_delay_days: avg delay_days; includes zeros; NULLs ignored. - Collaboration/recency: • unique_assignees: distinct assignee_user_id (non-null). • recent_task_creation: tasks created within the last 7 days (relative to current_date). • recent_task_completion: tasks completed within the last 7 days (relative to current_date). - Also select project attributes: id, name, created_at, due_date, owner_user_id, current_status, team_id. 3) project_health_metrics: - Percentages rounded to 2 decimals; when denominator is 0, set to 0: • completion_percentage = completed_tasks / total_tasks * 100. • assignment_percentage = assigned_tasks / total_tasks * 100. • overdue_percentage = overdue_tasks / total_tasks * 100. • quality_percentage = quality_tasks / completed_tasks * 100. • risk_percentage = (overdue + poor_performance + delayed) / total_tasks * 100 (may exceed 100 when categories overlap). • activity_percentage = (recent_task_creation + recent_task_completion) / total_tasks * 100 (may exceed 100 when both occur for the same task). - project_age_days = days from project_created_at to current_date. - deadline_status: no_deadline if due_date is null; on_time if due_date > today; due_today if equal; else overdue. - days_to_deadline: days from today to due_date; negative if past due; NULL if no due date. 4) project_health_scores (each clamped to [0,25]): - progress_score by completion_percentage: ≥90→25; ≥75→20; ≥50→15; ≥25→10; else 5. - quality_score by quality_percentage: ≥90→25; ≥75→20; ≥60→15; ≥40→10; else 5. - risk_score by risk_percentage (lower is better): ≤5→25; ≤10→20; ≤20→15; ≤35→10; else 5. - resource_score by assignment_percentage (and diversity): ≥95 and unique_assignees ≥ 2→25; else ≥85→20; ≥70→15; ≥50→10; else 5. 5) final_health_assessment: - overall_health_score = progress_score + quality_score + risk_score + resource_score (0–100). - health_grade: ≥90 excellent; ≥75 good; ≥60 fair; ≥40 poor; else critical. - risk_level (top-down): high_risk if risk_percentage ≥50 or overdue_percentage ≥30; else medium_risk if risk_percentage ≥25 or overdue_percentage ≥15; else low_risk if risk_percentage ≥10 or overdue_percentage ≥5; else minimal_risk. - project_forecast (top-down): overdue if deadline_status=''overdue''; else at_risk if risk_percentage ≥40 and days_to_deadline ≤ 7; else on_track if completion_percentage ≥75 and risk_percentage ≤15; else progressing if completion_percentage ≥50 and risk_percentage ≤25; else slow_progress if completion_percentage ≥25; else stalled. - focus_areas: concatenate applicable labels in fixed order [progress, quality, risk_management, resource_allocation, deadline_management, task_assignment] using ", "; include a label when its condition holds (score < 15; overdue_percentage > 20; unassigned_tasks > 30% of total); trim trailing delimiter; empty string if none. 6) validated_results and output: - is_valid_record = true only if project_id present; project_name non-empty; total_tasks ≥ 0; completed_tasks ≤ total_tasks; completion_percentage and quality_percentage in [0,100]; overall_health_score in [0,100]. - anomaly_flag: ''no_tasks'' if total_tasks=0; ''status_mismatch'' if completion_percentage=100 and project_status!=''completed''; ''excessive_overdue'' if overdue_percentage>50; ''poor_assignment'' if unassigned_tasks > 50% of total; ''stale_project'' if project_age_days>365 and completion_percentage<25; else ''normal''. - Final output filters to is_valid_record = true and orders by overall_health_score descending, then project_id.'
      columns:
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Asana project identifier; grouping key for one output row per project
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: project_name

      - name: recent_task_completion

      - name: completion_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Completed_tasks/Total_tasks*100 rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if total_tasks=0; bounded 0–100
      - name: assignment_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Assigned_tasks/Total_tasks*100 rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if total_tasks=0; bounded 0–100
      - name: overdue_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Overdue_tasks/Total_tasks*100 rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if total_tasks=0; bounded 0–100
      - name: quality_percentage

      - name: risk_percentage

      - name: project_age_days

      - name: deadline_status

      - name: progress_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score 0–25 by completion_percentage: ≥90→25, ≥75→20, ≥50→15, ≥25→10, else 5'
      - name: quality_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score 0–25 by quality_percentage: ≥90→25, ≥75→20, ≥60→15, ≥40→10, else 5'
      - name: risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score 0–25 by risk_percentage (lower is better): ≤5→25, ≤10→20, ≤20→15, ≤35→10, else 5'
      - name: resource_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score 0–25 by assignment_percentage with bonus: ≥95 and unique_assignees≥2→25; else ≥85→20, ≥70→15, ≥50→10, else 5'
      - name: overall_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of progress_score + quality_score + risk_score + resource_score; range 0–100

      - name: focus_areas
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma+space separated labels from [progress, quality, risk_management, resource_allocation, deadline_management, task_assignment] included per rule; fixed order; no duplicates; empty string if none
      - name: is_valid_record
        data_type: BOOLEAN

      - name: anomaly_flag

        description: One of 'normal','no_tasks','status_mismatch','excessive_overdue','poor_assignment','stale_project' based on anomaly rules

WITH project_base AS (
 SELECT * FROM staging.stg_asana__project WHERE project_name IS NOT NULL AND created_at IS NOT NULL
), joined AS (
 SELECT p.project_id,p.project_name,p.created_at AS project_created_at,p.due_date AS project_due_date,p.owner_user_id AS project_owner,p.current_status AS project_status,p.team_id,
        pt.task_id,t.is_completed,t.assignee_user_id,pm.task_status_category,pm.performance_grade,pm.urgency_score,pm.health_score,pm.complexity_score,pm.days_open,pm.response_time_days,pm.delay_days,t.created_at task_created_at,t.completed_at
 FROM project_base p LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__project_task rel ON p.project_id=rel.project_id::VARCHAR
 LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__task t ON rel.task_id::VARCHAR=t.task_id
 LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics pm ON t.task_id=pm.task_id
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT project_id, task_id FROM staging.stg_asana__project_task) pt ON pt.project_id=rel.project_id AND pt.task_id=rel.task_id
), agg AS (
 SELECT project_id,project_name,project_created_at,project_due_date,project_owner,project_status,team_id,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id)::BIGINT total_tasks,COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE is_completed)::BIGINT completed_tasks,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE is_completed=FALSE)::BIGINT active_tasks,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL)::BIGINT assigned_tasks,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE is_completed=FALSE AND assignee_user_id IS NULL)::BIGINT unassigned_tasks,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE task_status_category='overdue')::BIGINT overdue_tasks,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE performance_grade='poor')::BIGINT poor_performance_tasks,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE urgency_score>=4)::BIGINT high_urgency_tasks,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE delay_days>0)::BIGINT delayed_tasks,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE performance_grade IN ('excellent','good'))::BIGINT quality_tasks,
 AVG(health_score) avg_task_health_score,AVG(complexity_score) avg_task_complexity,
 AVG(days_open) FILTER(WHERE is_completed) avg_completion_time_days,AVG(response_time_days) avg_response_time_days,
 MAX(days_open)::BIGINT max_task_age_days,AVG(delay_days) avg_delay_days,COUNT(DISTINCT assignee_user_id)::BIGINT unique_assignees,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE task_created_at>=CURRENT_DATE-INTERVAL '7 days')::BIGINT recent_task_creation,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE completed_at>=CURRENT_DATE-INTERVAL '7 days')::BIGINT recent_task_completion
 FROM joined GROUP BY ALL
), pct AS (
 SELECT *,ROUND(100.0*completed_tasks/NULLIF(total_tasks,0),2) completion_percentage,ROUND(100.0*assigned_tasks/NULLIF(total_tasks,0),2) assignment_percentage,
 ROUND(100.0*overdue_tasks/NULLIF(total_tasks,0),2) overdue_percentage,ROUND(100.0*quality_tasks/NULLIF(completed_tasks,0),2) quality_percentage,
 ROUND(100.0*(overdue_tasks+poor_performance_tasks+delayed_tasks)/NULLIF(total_tasks,0),2) risk_percentage,
 ROUND(100.0*(recent_task_creation+recent_task_completion)/NULLIF(total_tasks,0),2) activity_percentage,
 DATE_DIFF('day',project_created_at::DATE,CURRENT_DATE)::BIGINT project_age_days,
 CASE WHEN project_due_date IS NULL THEN 'no_deadline' WHEN project_due_date::DATE>CURRENT_DATE THEN 'on_time' WHEN project_due_date::DATE=CURRENT_DATE THEN 'due_today' ELSE 'overdue' END deadline_status,
 DATE_DIFF('day',CURRENT_DATE,project_due_date::DATE)::BIGINT days_to_deadline FROM agg
), scores AS (
 SELECT *,COALESCE(completion_percentage,0) cp,COALESCE(assignment_percentage,0) ap,COALESCE(overdue_percentage,0) op,COALESCE(quality_percentage,0) qp,COALESCE(risk_percentage,0) rp,
 CASE WHEN total_tasks=0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(completion_percentage,0) END cpct,
 CASE WHEN COALESCE(completion_percentage,0)>=90 THEN 25 WHEN completion_percentage>=75 THEN 20 WHEN completion_percentage>=50 THEN 15 WHEN completion_percentage>=25 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END progress_score,
 CASE WHEN COALESCE(quality_percentage,0)>=90 THEN 25 WHEN quality_percentage>=75 THEN 20 WHEN quality_percentage>=60 THEN 15 WHEN quality_percentage>=40 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END quality_score,
 CASE WHEN COALESCE(risk_percentage,0)<=5 THEN 25 WHEN risk_percentage<=10 THEN 20 WHEN risk_percentage<=20 THEN 15 WHEN risk_percentage<=35 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END risk_score,
 CASE WHEN COALESCE(assignment_percentage,0)>=95 AND unique_assignees>=2 THEN 25 WHEN assignment_percentage>=85 THEN 20 WHEN assignment_percentage>=70 THEN 15 WHEN assignment_percentage>=50 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END resource_score
 FROM pct
), labels AS (
 SELECT *, progress_score+quality_score+risk_score+resource_score AS overall_health_score,
 CASE WHEN progress_score+quality_score+risk_score+resource_score>=90 THEN 'excellent' WHEN progress_score+quality_score+risk_score+resource_score>=75 THEN 'good' WHEN progress_score+quality_score+risk_score+resource_score>=60 THEN 'fair' WHEN progress_score+quality_score+risk_score+resource_score>=40 THEN 'poor' ELSE 'critical' END health_grade,
 CASE WHEN risk_percentage>=50 OR overdue_percentage>=30 THEN 'high_risk' WHEN risk_percentage>=25 OR overdue_percentage>=15 THEN 'medium_risk' WHEN risk_percentage>=10 OR overdue_percentage>=5 THEN 'low_risk' ELSE 'minimal_risk' END risk_level,
 CASE WHEN deadline_status='overdue' THEN 'overdue' WHEN risk_percentage>=40 AND days_to_deadline<=7 THEN 'at_risk' WHEN completion_percentage>=75 AND risk_percentage<=15 THEN 'on_track' WHEN completion_percentage>=50 AND risk_percentage<=25 THEN 'progressing' WHEN completion_percentage>=25 THEN 'slow_progress' ELSE 'stalled' END project_forecast,
 concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN progress_score<15 THEN 'progress' END,CASE WHEN quality_score<15 THEN 'quality' END,CASE WHEN risk_score<15 THEN 'risk_management' END,CASE WHEN resource_score<15 THEN 'resource_allocation' END,CASE WHEN overdue_percentage>20 THEN 'deadline_management' END,CASE WHEN total_tasks>0 AND unassigned_tasks>0.3*total_tasks THEN 'task_assignment' END) focus_areas
 FROM scores
), final AS (
 SELECT *, total_tasks>=0 AND completed_tasks<=total_tasks AND completion_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND quality_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND overall_health_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AS is_valid_record,
 CASE WHEN total_tasks=0 THEN 'no_tasks' WHEN completion_percentage=100 AND project_status<>'completed' THEN 'status_mismatch' WHEN overdue_percentage>50 THEN 'excessive_overdue' WHEN total_tasks>0 AND unassigned_tasks>0.5*total_tasks THEN 'poor_assignment' WHEN project_age_days>365 AND completion_percentage<25 THEN 'stale_project' ELSE 'normal' END anomaly_flag
 FROM labels
)

- name: int_asana__task_performance_metrics
      description: Task performance metrics with lifecycle status, response/delay days, activity/urgency/complexity scores, validity flag, performance grade, and health score; only valid records are output.
      grain: One row per task_id (only records with is_valid_record = true)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__task
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_open_length
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_story
      business_logic: 'Data preparation: - Use tasks where created_at is present from staging.stg_asana__task. - Bring per-task durations from intermediate.int_asana__task_open_length (days_open, days_since_first_assignment, days_since_last_assignment). - Use stories from intermediate.int_asana__task_story where action_taken is present. Timeline and status: - For each task_id, left join open-length metrics. - Assign task_status_category using ordered rules: - unassigned: no assignee and not completed - assigned_active: has assignee and not completed - completed_on_time: completed_at on or before due_date - completed_late: completed_at after due_date - overdue: not completed and today is after the due_date’s calendar date - otherwise active - first_assigned_at: the earliest story timestamp where action_taken = ''assigned'' for this task; null if none. - last_activity_at: the later of modified_at and the latest story timestamp for the task; if no story exists, use created_at. Metrics: - response_time_days: number of days from created_at to first_assigned_at when first_assigned_at exists; otherwise null (expected non-negative). - delay_days: - If due_date exists and the task is completed late: days between due_date and completed_at. - If due_date exists and the task is still open and past due today: days between due_date and today. - Otherwise 0 (never negative). - activity_score (1–5) based on days since last_activity_at: - 0–1 days → 5; 2–3 → 4; 4–7 → 3; 8–14 → 2; else 1. - urgency_score (1–5) only when due_date exists and the task is not completed: - due in 0–1 days → 5; 2–3 → 4; 4–7 → 3; 8–30 → 2; else 1; otherwise 1. - complexity_score (1–3) from description length (treat missing description as empty): - >500 chars → 3; >100 → 2; else 1. Constraints and classifications: - is_valid_record is true only if task_name is not blank, created_at is present, days_open ≥ 0, response_time_days is not negative (null allowed), and delay_days ≥ 0. - performance_grade: - completed with delay_days = 0 and response_time_days ≤ 1 → excellent - completed with delay_days ≤ 2 and response_time_days ≤ 2 → good - completed with delay_days ≤ 5 → fair - completed with delay_days > 5 → poor - not completed and status is overdue → at_risk - otherwise pending. Health score: - Start from 0 and add components, then clamp to [0,100]: - Activity: add 20 points per activity_score unit (1–5). - Timeliness: add 25 if delay_days = 0; otherwise subtract 5 points per day of delay down to 0. - Responsiveness: add 25 if response_time_days ≤ 1; otherwise subtract 3 points per day down to 0. - Assignment: add 15 if an assignee is present; else 0. - Description: add 15 if description is present; else 0. Output: - Return rows with is_valid_record = true. - Sort by health_score (descending), then urgency_score (descending), then task_id.'
      columns:
      - name: task_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique task identifier; exactly one output row per task_id that passes validity checks
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: task_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Task display name/title sourced from stg_asana__task; must be non-null and non-blank
      - name: task_description
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Task description text from stg_asana__task; presence contributes to health_score
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Original task creation timestamp; non-null by filter and used in multiple day-based calculations
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: modified_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Most recent task modification timestamp used to determine last_activity_at; may be null
      - name: completed_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp when the task was completed; used to label completed_on_time vs completed_late and to compute delay_days
      - name: due_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Target due timestamp used for status, urgency_score, and delay_days; overdue checks compare the due date’s calendar date to today
      - name: is_completed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Completion flag from stg_asana__task used in status, delay_days, urgency_score, and performance_grade
      - name: assignee_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Assigned user id (nullable); presence affects status and adds +15 to health_score
      - name: task_status_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Lifecycle status from ordered rules: unassigned, assigned_active, completed_on_time, completed_late, overdue, or active'
      - name: first_assigned_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest story timestamp where action_taken='assigned' for this task; null if never assigned
      - name: last_activity_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Later of modified_at and the latest story timestamp; if no story exists, uses created_at
      - name: days_open
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Non-negative days the task has been open sourced from int_asana__task_open_length
      - name: days_since_first_assignment
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days since the first assignment sourced from int_asana__task_open_length
      - name: days_since_last_assignment
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days since the most recent assignment sourced from int_asana__task_open_length
      - name: response_time_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from created_at to first_assigned_at; null if never assigned; must not be negative
      - name: delay_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days overdue (0 if due_date absent or on time); completed late uses days between due_date and completed_at; open overdue uses days between due_date and today
      - name: activity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1–5 score based on days since last_activity_at vs now (≤1→5, ≤3→4, ≤7→3, ≤14→2, else 1)
      - name: urgency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1–5 score when due_date present and not completed, based on days until due_date thresholds; otherwise 1
      - name: complexity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: '1–3 score based on description length: >500→3, >100→2, else 1'
      - name: is_valid_record
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True only if task_name not blank, created_at present, and days_open/response_time_days/delay_days are not negative
        tests:
        - accepted_values:
            values:
            - true
      - name: performance_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Classification: excellent, good, fair, poor, at_risk, or pending per rules combining completion, delay_days, and response_time_days'
      - name: health_score
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Overall 0–100 score from weighted components (activity, timeliness, responsiveness, assignment, description) clamped to [0,100]

WITH tasks AS (
 SELECT t.*, ol.days_open, ol.days_since_first_assignment, ol.days_since_last_assignment,
        a.first_assigned_at,
        COALESCE((SELECT MAX(s.created_at) FROM intermediate.int_asana__task_story s WHERE s.target_task_id=t.task_id), t.created_at) AS latest_story_at
 FROM staging.stg_asana__task t LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_asana__task_open_length ol ON t.task_id=ol.task_id
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT target_task_id, MIN(created_at) first_assigned_at FROM intermediate.int_asana__task_story WHERE action_taken='assigned' GROUP BY target_task_id) a ON t.task_id=a.target_task_id
 WHERE t.created_at IS NOT NULL
), calculated AS (
 SELECT *, CASE WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NULL THEN 'unassigned'
 WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'assigned_active'
 WHEN is_completed AND completed_at::DATE <= due_date::DATE THEN 'completed_on_time'
 WHEN is_completed AND completed_at::DATE > due_date::DATE THEN 'completed_late'
 WHEN NOT is_completed AND due_date::DATE < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'overdue' ELSE 'active' END AS task_status_category,
 CASE WHEN due_date IS NOT NULL AND is_completed AND completed_at::DATE > due_date::DATE THEN DATE_DIFF('day',due_date::DATE,completed_at::DATE)
      WHEN due_date IS NOT NULL AND NOT is_completed AND due_date::DATE < CURRENT_DATE THEN DATE_DIFF('day',due_date::DATE,CURRENT_DATE) ELSE 0 END::BIGINT AS delay_days,
 CASE WHEN first_assigned_at IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_DIFF('day',created_at,first_assigned_at) END::BIGINT AS response_time_days,
 CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',latest_story_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)<=1 THEN 5 WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',latest_story_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)<=3 THEN 4 WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',latest_story_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)<=7 THEN 3 WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',latest_story_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)<=14 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS activity_score,
 CASE WHEN due_date IS NULL OR is_completed THEN 1 WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',CURRENT_DATE,due_date::DATE)<=1 THEN 5 WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',CURRENT_DATE,due_date::DATE)<=3 THEN 4 WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',CURRENT_DATE,due_date::DATE)<=7 THEN 3 WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',CURRENT_DATE,due_date::DATE)<=30 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS urgency_score,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(task_description,''))>500 THEN 3 WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(task_description,''))>100 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS complexity_score
 FROM tasks
), classified AS (
 SELECT *, (task_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(task_name))>0 AND days_open>=0 AND (response_time_days IS NULL OR response_time_days>=0) AND delay_days>=0) AS is_valid_record,
 CASE WHEN is_completed AND delay_days=0 AND response_time_days<=1 THEN 'excellent'
 WHEN is_completed AND delay_days<=2 AND response_time_days<=2 THEN 'good'
 WHEN is_completed AND delay_days<=5 THEN 'fair' WHEN is_completed AND delay_days>5 THEN 'poor'
 WHEN NOT is_completed AND task_status_category='overdue' THEN 'at_risk' ELSE 'pending' END AS performance_grade,
 GREATEST(0,LEAST(100,activity_score*20 + CASE WHEN delay_days=0 THEN 25 ELSE GREATEST(0,25-delay_days*5) END + CASE WHEN response_time_days<=1 THEN 25 WHEN response_time_days IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0,25-response_time_days*3) END + CASE WHEN assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 15 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN COALESCE(task_description,'')<>'' THEN 15 ELSE 0 END))::BIGINT AS health_score
 FROM calculated
)
SELECT task_id,task_name,task_description,created_at,modified_at,completed_at,due_date,is_completed,assignee_user_id,task_status_category,first_assigned_at,latest_story_at AS last_activity_at,
 days_open,days_since_first_assignment,days_since_last_assignment,response_time_days,delay_days,activity_score,urgency_score,complexity_score,is_valid_record,performance_grade,health_score
FROM classified WHERE is_valid_record

WHEN is_completed AND completed_at::DATE <= due_date::DATE THEN 'completed_on_time'
 WHEN is_completed AND completed_at::DATE > due_date::DATE THEN 'completed_late'

- name: asana__daily_metrics
      description: Daily counts of tasks created, tasks completed, and their net difference, aggregated by calendar day.
      grain: One row per date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__task (created_at, completed_at)
      business_logic: 'Build two daily aggregates from staging.stg_asana__task: - Creations: for each task, take the calendar day of its creation timestamp; tasks missing a creation timestamp are counted under a single NULL day; count tasks per day and label as task_created. - Completions: for each task with a completion timestamp, take the calendar day of that timestamp; count tasks per day and label as task_completed. Combine both sets without deduplication, then for each day: - tasks_created = total counts from task_created entries for that day (else 0). - tasks_completed = total counts from task_completed entries for that day (else 0). - net_task_change = tasks_created minus tasks_completed. Output one row per day present in either set (including a NULL day if any tasks lack a creation timestamp), ordered ascending by date_day.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Calendar day used for aggregation (midnight in its time zone); may be NULL only from missing created_at; one row per distinct value.
      - name: tasks_created
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of tasks whose creation timestamp falls on date_day; 0 if none; never NULL.
      - name: tasks_completed
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of tasks with a completion timestamp that falls on date_day; 0 if none; never NULL.
      - name: net_task_change
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: tasks_created minus tasks_completed for the same date_day; can be negative; never NULL.

WITH creations AS (
    SELECT CAST(CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS date_day,
           COUNT(*)::HUGEINT AS tasks_created
    FROM staging.stg_asana__task
    GROUP BY CAST(created_at AS DATE)
),
completions AS (
    SELECT CAST(CAST(completed_at AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS date_day,
           COUNT(*)::HUGEINT AS tasks_completed
    FROM staging.stg_asana__task
    WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(completed_at AS DATE)
),
days AS (
    SELECT date_day FROM creations
    UNION
    SELECT date_day FROM completions
)
SELECT d.date_day,
       COALESCE(c.tasks_created, 0)::HUGEINT AS tasks_created,
       COALESCE(x.tasks_completed, 0)::HUGEINT AS tasks_completed,
       (COALESCE(c.tasks_created, 0) - COALESCE(x.tasks_completed, 0))::HUGEINT AS net_task_change
FROM days d
LEFT JOIN creations c ON d.date_day IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.date_day
LEFT JOIN completions x ON d.date_day IS NOT DISTINCT FROM x.date_day
ORDER BY d.date_day
CAST(CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'

- name: asana__project_analytics
      description: Executive-level Asana project analytics with health, workload, schedule, scoring, ROI, maturity, priorities, and ranks; only valid projects are output
      grain: One row per project_id (valid records only)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__project
      - staging.stg_asana__team
      - intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators
      business_logic: 'Build analytics in stages: - Filter projects to those with a non-null project_name. - Join team details by team_id and health indicators by project_id. - Derive schedule metrics: - planned_duration_days: whole days from start (created_at) to deadline if a deadline exists; otherwise null. - elapsed_days: whole days from start to today. - remaining_days: whole days from today to deadline if a deadline exists; otherwise null. - completion_rate_per_day: completion_percentage divided by elapsed_days, rounded to 4 decimals; null if elapsed_days is not positive. - Resource/workload metrics: - avg_tasks_per_assignee: if total_tasks > 0, divide total_tasks by max(1, unique_assignees) and round to 2 decimals; if unique_assignees is null in this case, the result is null; otherwise 0. - team_size_category by unique_assignees: 0 → no_team; 1 → solo_project; 2–3 → small_team; 4–7 → medium_team; 8–15 → large_team; else enterprise_team (null maps to enterprise_team). - project_size_category by total_tasks: 0–5 → micro_project; 6–20 → small_project; 21–50 → medium_project; 51–100 → large_project; else enterprise_project (null maps to enterprise_project). - estimated_days_to_completion: when completion_rate_per_day > 0 and completion_percentage < 100, (100 − completion_percentage) divided by completion_rate_per_day, rounded up to whole days; otherwise null. - schedule_forecast: if completion_rate_per_day > 0 and completion_percentage < 100, compare estimated_days_to_completion to remaining_days: ≤ remaining_days → on_schedule; ≤ remaining_days × 1.2 → slight_delay; ≤ remaining_days × 1.5 → moderate_delay; else significant_delay. Otherwise, if completion_percentage = 100 → completed; else if remaining_days < 0 → overdue; else uncertain. - Performance scoring: - efficiency_score (0–25): by completion_rate_per_day thresholds, inclusive bands: ≥2.0 → 25; ≥1.0 → 20; ≥0.5 → 15; ≥0.2 → 10; else 5; then constrained to 0–25. - time_management_score (0–25): by schedule_forecast mapping: on_schedule 25; slight_delay 20; moderate_delay 15; significant_delay 10; overdue 5; else 12; constrained to 0–25. - collaboration_score (0–25): by avg_tasks_per_assignee and team size: if avg between 3 and 8 (inclusive) and unique_assignees ≥ 2 → 25; if avg between 2 and 12 → 20; if avg between 1 and 15 → 15; if unique_assignees ≥ 1 → 10; else 5; constrained to 0–25. - complexity_factor: enterprise_project 1.2; large_project 1.1; medium_project 1.0; small_project 0.9; micro_project 0.8. - Final analytics: - comprehensive_project_score: weighted sum of health (40%), efficiency (25%), time (20%), and collaboration (15%), multiplied by complexity_factor and rounded to 2 decimals. - roi_efficiency_ratio: if unique_assignees > 0 and elapsed_days > 0, compute (completion_percentage × quality_percentage ÷ 100) divided by (unique_assignees × elapsed_days ÷ 30), rounded to 3 decimals; otherwise 0. - project_maturity_phase by elapsed_days: ≤7 → startup_phase; ≤30 → early_development; ≤90 → active_development; ≤180 → mature_development; ≤365 → long_term_project; else legacy_project (null maps to legacy_project). - success_factors: concatenate, in this order, any applicable tokens separated by ", ": high_health (overall_health_score ≥ 80), strong_progress (completion_percentage ≥ 75), quality_delivery (quality_percentage ≥ 70), low_risk (risk_percentage ≤ 15), good_collaboration (unique_assignees ≥ 3), on_time (schedule_forecast is on_schedule or completed); remove any trailing comma and space; empty string if none. - improvement_opportunities: concatenate, in this order, any applicable tokens separated by ", ": improve_health (overall_health_score < 60), accelerate_progress (completion_percentage < 50 and elapsed_days > 30), enhance_quality (quality_percentage < 60), reduce_risks (risk_percentage > 25), balance_workload (avg_tasks_per_assignee > 10), address_delays (schedule_forecast is moderate_delay or significant_delay), expand_team (unique_assignees < 2 and total_tasks > 10); remove any trailing comma and space; empty string if none. - management_priority: immediate_attention if risk_level is high_risk or schedule_forecast is overdue; else high_priority if overall_health_score < 50 or schedule_forecast is significant_delay; else monitor if overall_health_score ≥ 80 and schedule_forecast is on_schedule; otherwise regular_review. - Validation and ranking: - is_valid_record is true only when: project_id and project_name are present; comprehensive_project_score is between 0 and 120 inclusive; completion_percentage, quality_percentage, and risk_percentage are each between 0 and 100 inclusive; total_tasks and completed_tasks are not negative; and completed_tasks does not exceed total_tasks. - Ranks are computed across all rows before filtering: overall_performance_rank by comprehensive_project_score descending; health_rank by overall_health_score descending; progress_rank by completion_percentage descending; efficiency_rank by roi_efficiency_ratio descending. Ties share the same rank with gaps. - Output: return only rows where is_valid_record is true, ordered by comprehensive_project_score descending, then overall_health_score descending, then project_id ascending.'
      columns:
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project identifier from Asana; grouping key with at most one output row per project_id
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project name from source; rows with null project_name are excluded
      - name: team_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Team identifier associated with the project; null if no matching team
      - name: team_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Team name joined by team_id; null if no match
      - name: project_owner
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner user identifier from the project record (no user lookup applied)
      - name: project_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current project status from the source (passthrough)
      - name: project_start_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Project start timestamp from created_at
      - name: project_deadline
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Project due date timestamp; may be null
      - name: total_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total task count from health indicators; must be nonnegative for validity
      - name: completed_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Completed task count from health indicators; must be between 0 and total_tasks
      - name: active_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Active or in-progress task count from health indicators; may be null
      - name: overdue_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Past-due, incomplete task count from health indicators; may be null
      - name: unique_assignees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct assignee count from health indicators; 0 means no assignees; may be null
      - name: completion_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent of tasks completed from health indicators; expected 0–100 for validity
      - name: quality_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent meeting quality criteria from health indicators; expected 0–100 for validity
      - name: risk_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent flagged as risky from health indicators; expected 0–100 for validity
      - name: overall_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Overall health score from health indicators used in composite scoring
      - name: health_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Health grade label from health indicators
      - name: risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Risk level label from health indicators (e.g., high_risk)
      - name: project_forecast
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Forecast label from health indicators, distinct from schedule_forecast
      - name: focus_areas
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Focus areas text from health indicators
      - name: planned_duration_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days from start to deadline; null if no deadline
      - name: elapsed_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days since start; null if start date is null
      - name: remaining_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days until deadline; negative if overdue; null if no deadline
      - name: completion_rate_per_day
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Completion percentage per day since start, rounded to 4 decimals; null if elapsed_days is not positive
      - name: avg_tasks_per_assignee
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If total_tasks > 0, total_tasks divided by max(1, unique_assignees) rounded to 2 decimals (null if unique_assignees is null); otherwise 0
      - name: team_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Team size bucket by unique_assignees: no_team, solo_project, small_team, medium_team, large_team, or enterprise_team (null maps to enterprise_team)'
      - name: project_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Project size bucket by total_tasks: micro_project, small_project, medium_project, large_project, or enterprise_project (null maps to enterprise_project)'
      - name: estimated_days_to_completion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Remaining percent divided by daily completion rate and rounded up when rate > 0 and completion < 100; otherwise null
      - name: schedule_forecast
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Outlook: on_schedule, slight_delay, moderate_delay, significant_delay, completed, overdue, or uncertain based on thresholds and gating rules'
      - name: efficiency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 score from completion_rate_per_day thresholds, constrained to 0–25
      - name: time_management_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 score from schedule_forecast mapping, constrained to 0–25
      - name: collaboration_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 score from avg_tasks_per_assignee and team size, constrained to 0–25
      - name: complexity_factor
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: 'Multiplier by project_size_category: micro 0.8, small 0.9, medium 1.0, large 1.1, enterprise 1.2'
      - name: comprehensive_project_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Weighted health (40%), efficiency (25%), time (20%), and collaboration (15%) scaled by complexity and rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: roi_efficiency_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Efficiency of progress and quality relative to team size and time, rounded to 3 decimals; 0 when team size or elapsed_days is not positive
      - name: project_maturity_phase
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Lifecycle phase by elapsed_days: startup_phase, early_development, active_development, mature_development, long_term_project, or legacy_project'
      - name: success_factors
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated tokens for strong signals in a fixed order; trailing comma and space removed; empty string if none
      - name: improvement_opportunities
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated tokens for weak signals in a fixed order; trailing comma and space removed; empty string if none
      - name: management_priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Priority recommendation: immediate_attention, high_priority, monitor, or regular_review based on risk, health, and schedule'
      - name: is_valid_record
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True only when all validation checks pass; output includes only true rows
      - name: overall_performance_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank by comprehensive_project_score descending across all rows before filtering; ties share rank with gaps
      - name: health_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank by overall_health_score descending across all rows before filtering; ties share rank with gaps
      - name: progress_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank by completion_percentage descending across all rows before filtering; ties share rank with gaps
      - name: efficiency_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank by roi_efficiency_ratio descending across all rows before filtering; ties share rank with gaps

WITH base AS (
 SELECT p.project_id,p.project_name,p.team_id,t.team_name,p.owner_user_id project_owner,p.current_status project_status,p.created_at project_start_date,p.due_date project_deadline,
 h.total_tasks,h.completed_tasks,h.active_tasks,h.overdue_tasks,h.unique_assignees,h.completion_percentage,h.quality_percentage,h.risk_percentage,h.overall_health_score,h.health_grade,h.risk_level,h.project_forecast,h.focus_areas,
 DATE_DIFF('day',p.created_at::DATE,p.due_date::DATE)::BIGINT planned_duration_days,DATE_DIFF('day',p.created_at::DATE,CURRENT_DATE)::BIGINT elapsed_days,DATE_DIFF('day',CURRENT_DATE,p.due_date::DATE)::BIGINT remaining_days
 FROM staging.stg_asana__project p LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__team t ON p.team_id::VARCHAR=t.team_id LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators h ON p.project_id=h.project_id
 WHERE p.project_name IS NOT NULL
), derived AS (
 SELECT *,ROUND(completion_percentage/NULLIF(elapsed_days,0),4) completion_rate_per_day,
 CASE WHEN total_tasks>0 AND unique_assignees IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(total_tasks::DOUBLE/GREATEST(1,unique_assignees),2) WHEN total_tasks>0 THEN NULL ELSE 0 END avg_tasks_per_assignee,
 CASE WHEN unique_assignees=0 THEN 'no_team' WHEN unique_assignees=1 THEN 'solo_project' WHEN unique_assignees<=3 THEN 'small_team' WHEN unique_assignees<=7 THEN 'medium_team' WHEN unique_assignees<=15 THEN 'large_team' ELSE 'enterprise_team' END team_size_category,
 CASE WHEN total_tasks<=5 THEN 'micro_project' WHEN total_tasks<=20 THEN 'small_project' WHEN total_tasks<=50 THEN 'medium_project' WHEN total_tasks<=100 THEN 'large_project' ELSE 'enterprise_project' END project_size_category
 FROM base
), scored AS (
 SELECT *,CASE WHEN completion_rate_per_day>0 AND completion_percentage<100 THEN CEIL((100-completion_percentage)/completion_rate_per_day) END estimated_days_to_completion,
 CASE WHEN completion_rate_per_day>0 AND completion_percentage<100 THEN CASE WHEN CEIL((100-completion_percentage)/completion_rate_per_day)<=remaining_days THEN 'on_schedule' WHEN CEIL((100-completion_percentage)/completion_rate_per_day)<=remaining_days*1.2 THEN 'slight_delay' WHEN CEIL((100-completion_percentage)/completion_rate_per_day)<=remaining_days*1.5 THEN 'moderate_delay' ELSE 'significant_delay' END WHEN completion_percentage=100 THEN 'completed' WHEN remaining_days<0 THEN 'overdue' ELSE 'uncertain' END schedule_forecast,
 CASE WHEN completion_rate_per_day>=2 THEN 25 WHEN completion_rate_per_day>=1 THEN 20 WHEN completion_rate_per_day>=.5 THEN 15 WHEN completion_rate_per_day>=.2 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END efficiency_score,
 CASE WHEN completion_percentage=100 THEN 25 WHEN remaining_days<0 THEN 5 ELSE 12 END time_management_score,
 CASE WHEN avg_tasks_per_assignee BETWEEN 3 AND 8 AND unique_assignees>=2 THEN 25 WHEN avg_tasks_per_assignee BETWEEN 2 AND 12 THEN 20 WHEN avg_tasks_per_assignee BETWEEN 1 AND 15 THEN 15 WHEN unique_assignees>=1 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END collaboration_score,
 CASE project_size_category WHEN 'enterprise_project' THEN 1.2 WHEN 'large_project' THEN 1.1 WHEN 'medium_project' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'small_project' THEN .9 ELSE .8 END::DECIMAL(2,1) complexity_factor
 FROM derived
), totals AS (
 SELECT *,ROUND((overall_health_score*.4+efficiency_score*.25+time_management_score*.2+collaboration_score*.15)*complexity_factor,2)::DECIMAL(18,2) comprehensive_project_score,
 CASE WHEN unique_assignees>0 AND elapsed_days>0 THEN ROUND((completion_percentage*quality_percentage/100.0)/(unique_assignees*elapsed_days/30.0),3) ELSE 0 END roi_efficiency_ratio,
 CASE WHEN elapsed_days<=7 THEN 'startup_phase' WHEN elapsed_days<=30 THEN 'early_development' WHEN elapsed_days<=90 THEN 'active_development' WHEN elapsed_days<=180 THEN 'mature_development' WHEN elapsed_days<=365 THEN 'long_term_project' ELSE 'legacy_project' END project_maturity_phase
 FROM scored
), ranked AS (
 SELECT *,concat_ws(', ',CASE WHEN overall_health_score>=80 THEN 'high_health' END,CASE WHEN completion_percentage>=75 THEN 'strong_progress' END,CASE WHEN quality_percentage>=70 THEN 'quality_delivery' END,CASE WHEN risk_percentage<=15 THEN 'low_risk' END,CASE WHEN unique_assignees>=3 THEN 'good_collaboration' END,CASE WHEN schedule_forecast IN ('on_schedule','completed') THEN 'on_time' END) success_factors,
 concat_ws(', ',CASE WHEN overall_health_score<60 THEN 'improve_health' END,CASE WHEN completion_percentage<50 AND elapsed_days>30 THEN 'accelerate_progress' END,CASE WHEN quality_percentage<60 THEN 'enhance_quality' END,CASE WHEN risk_percentage>25 THEN 'reduce_risks' END,CASE WHEN avg_tasks_per_assignee>10 THEN 'balance_workload' END,CASE WHEN schedule_forecast IN ('moderate_delay','significant_delay') THEN 'address_delays' END,CASE WHEN unique_assignees<2 AND total_tasks>10 THEN 'expand_team' END) improvement_opportunities,
 CASE WHEN risk_level='high_risk' OR schedule_forecast='overdue' THEN 'immediate_attention' WHEN overall_health_score<50 OR schedule_forecast='significant_delay' THEN 'high_priority' WHEN overall_health_score>=80 AND schedule_forecast='on_schedule' THEN 'monitor' ELSE 'regular_review' END management_priority
 FROM totals
), final AS (SELECT *,RANK() OVER(ORDER BY comprehensive_project_score DESC) overall_performance_rank,RANK() OVER(ORDER BY overall_health_score DESC) health_rank,RANK() OVER(ORDER BY completion_percentage DESC) progress_rank,RANK() OVER(ORDER BY roi_efficiency_ratio DESC) efficiency_rank,
 (project_id IS NOT NULL AND project_name IS NOT NULL AND comprehensive_project_score BETWEEN 0 AND 120 AND completion_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND quality_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND risk_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND total_tasks>=0 AND completed_tasks>=0 AND completed_tasks<=total_tasks) is_valid_record FROM ranked)
SELECT * FROM final WHERE is_valid_record ORDER BY comprehensive_project_score DESC,overall_health_score DESC,project_id
CASE WHEN completion_percentage=100 THEN 25 WHEN remaining_days<0 THEN 5 ELSE 12 END time_management_score

- name: asana__task_lifecycle_analysis
      description: Deterministic lifecycle analytics per task with computed timings, classifications, pattern lists, and project/user context; outputs only records passing validation
      grain: One row per task_id per associated project (or one row if no project), after validation
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__task
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_story
      - staging.stg_asana__project
      - intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators
      - staging.stg_asana__project_task
      - staging.stg_asana__user
      business_logic: '1) Base rows: include tasks from staging.stg_asana__task where created_at is not null. 2) Join per-task metrics from intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics (task_status_category, performance_grade, health_score, response_time_days, delay_days, complexity_score, urgency_score, activity_score). 3) Build task stories from intermediate.int_asana__task_story where action_taken is not null and derive per task: - creation_timestamp: earliest ''created'' story, - first_assignment_timestamp: earliest ''assigned'' story, - last_assignment_timestamp: latest ''assigned'' story, - last_modification_timestamp: latest story across all actions, - completion_timestamp: earliest ''completed'' story, - Activity aggregates: total_story_events (count), unique_action_types (distinct action_taken), days_with_activity (distinct calendar dates of stories). 4) Compute lifecycle durations: - hours_to_assignment: hours from task.created_at to first_assignment_timestamp when first_assignment_timestamp exists; otherwise null, - hours_assigned_to_completion: hours from first_assignment_timestamp to task.completed_at when both exist; otherwise null, - total_lifecycle_hours: hours from task.created_at to task.completed_at if completed, else to the current time, - avg_daily_activity_rate: if lifecycle days from task.created_at to task.completed_at or current time > 0, then total_story_events divided by that day count rounded to two decimals; otherwise equals total_story_events. 5) Classifications and scores: - lifecycle_efficiency_category: • If completed: ''highly_efficient'' when hours_to_assignment<=24 and hours_assigned_to_completion<=168; ''efficient'' when <=72 and <=336; ''moderate'' when <=168 and <=720; ''slow_start'' when hours_to_assignment<=336; ''slow_completion'' when hours_assigned_to_completion>720; else ''inefficient''. • If not completed: ''stalled_unassigned'' when hours_to_assignment is null and total_lifecycle_hours>168; ''stalled_assigned'' when hours_to_assignment is not null and total_lifecycle_hours>720; ''urgent_delayed'' when urgency_score>=4 and total_lifecycle_hours>72; else ''in_progress''. - activity_level by avg_daily_activity_rate: >=2.0 ''very_active''; >=1.0 ''active''; >=0.5 ''moderate_activity''; >=0.1 ''low_activity''; else ''dormant''. - lifecycle_health_score: clamp to [0,100] the sum of: • Timeliness: completed on time=40; completed with delay_days<=2=30; <=7=20; completed late>7=10; if not completed and due_date>today=35; due today=25; overdue=5. • Response speed: response_time_days<=1=30; <=3=25; <=7=20; <=14=15; non-null else=10; null=5. • Activity: activity_score*4. • Complexity fit: complexity=1 and total_lifecycle_hours<=168=10; complexity=2 and <=336=10; complexity=3 and <=720=10; any task <=72 hours=8; else=5. - current_lifecycle_stage: ''backlog'' (not completed and no assignee); ''newly_assigned'' (not completed, assignee exists, and within 1 day of first assignment or creation if assignment missing); ''active_development'' (not completed, assignee exists, and modified within 7 days); ''stagnant'' (not completed, assignee exists, and last modification >7 days); ''completed_on_time'' (completed with delay_days=0); ''completed_delayed'' (completed with delay_days>0); else ''unknown_state''. 6) Pattern lists (tokens evaluated in fixed order, joined by ", ", and trimmed; empty string if none): - anomaly_patterns: ''delayed_assignment'' if hours_to_assignment>336; ''prolonged_execution'' if hours_assigned_to_completion>1440; ''dormant_task'' if avg_daily_activity_rate<0.1 and not completed; ''overengineered_simple'' if complexity_score=1 and total_lifecycle_hours>336; ''urgent_ignored'' if urgency_score>=4 and response_time_days>3; ''blocked_subtask'' if parent_task_id not null and total_lifecycle_hours>720; ''severely_delayed'' if delay_days>14; ''high_churn'' if total_story_events>50. - success_patterns: ''fast_track'' if lifecycle_efficiency_category=''highly_efficient''; ''exemplary_execution'' if completed, on time, and performance_grade=''excellent''; ''consistent_progress'' if avg_daily_activity_rate>=1.0 and completed; ''rapid_delivery'' if response_time_days<=1 and hours_assigned_to_completion<=168; ''complex_mastery'' if complexity_score=3 and lifecycle_health_score>=80; ''urgent_success'' if urgency_score>=4 and delay_days=0. - improvement_opportunities: ''faster_assignment'' if hours_to_assignment>72; ''increase_engagement'' if activity_level in (''low_activity'',''dormant''); ''improve_time_management'' if delay_days>0; ''enhance_responsiveness'' if response_time_days>3; ''overall_process_improvement'' if lifecycle_health_score<60; ''add_progress_updates'' if total_story_events<3 and not completed. - complexity_execution_match (first match wins): ''appropriate_simple'' if complexity_score=1 and total_lifecycle_hours<=72; ''appropriate_medium'' if complexity_score=2 and total_lifecycle_hours in 73–336; ''appropriate_complex'' if complexity_score=3 and total_lifecycle_hours in 337–720; ''faster_than_expected'' if total_lifecycle_hours < complexity_score*72; ''slower_than_expected'' if total_lifecycle_hours > complexity_score*240; else ''within_range''. 7) Project context: join staging.stg_asana__project_task on task_id, then staging.stg_asana__project left-joined to intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators to get project_name, team_id, and project_health_score (defaults to 50 when the project exists without indicators). Tasks with multiple projects yield one row per membership; tasks without a project retain a single row with null project fields. 8) User context: join staging.stg_asana__user by casting assignee_user_id to the user_id type to get assignee_name; assignee_performance_grade is always ''unknown'' for matched users. 9) Relative performance vs project: compare lifecycle_health_score to project_health_score and assign: >+20 ''above_project_average''; >+10 ''slightly_above_average''; >= -10 ''project_average''; >= -20 ''slightly_below_average''; else ''below_project_average'' (null project score falls into ''below_project_average''). 10) Data quality validation (is_valid_record): mark false when task_id or task_name is null; lifecycle_health_score outside [0,100]; any of total_lifecycle_hours, hours_to_assignment, hours_assigned_to_completion, or avg_daily_activity_rate is negative; or is_completed=true while both completion_timestamp and completed_at are null. Only rows with is_valid_record=true are kept, and results are sorted by lifecycle_health_score descending, then total_lifecycle_hours ascending, then task_id.'
      columns:
      - name: task_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Asana task identifier; may repeat across rows if the task belongs to multiple projects
      - name: task_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Task display name from stg_asana__task
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Task creation timestamp from stg_asana__task; non-null by model filter
      - name: completed_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Task completion timestamp from stg_asana__task; null if not completed
      - name: due_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Due date from stg_asana__task; may be null and is compared to current date in scoring
      - name: is_completed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if the task is marked completed in stg_asana__task
      - name: assignee_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Current assignee user_id from stg_asana__task; may be null
      - name: parent_task_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Parent task_id when this is a subtask; null otherwise
      - name: task_status_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Status category from int_asana__task_performance_metrics; passed through as-is
      - name: performance_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Performance grade from int_asana__task_performance_metrics; used in success_patterns
      - name: health_score
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Health score from int_asana__task_performance_metrics; not recomputed here
      - name: response_time_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from creation to first response from metrics; used in scoring and patterns; null treated as worst in scoring
      - name: delay_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days completed past due date from metrics; used in scoring and patterns
      - name: complexity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Complexity score from metrics (integer); used in complexity matching and scoring
      - name: urgency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Urgency score from metrics (integer); used in efficiency and patterns
      - name: activity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Activity score from metrics (integer); contributes to lifecycle_health_score as activity_score*4
      - name: creation_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest 'created' story timestamp; may be null
      - name: first_assignment_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest 'assigned' story timestamp; null if never assigned
      - name: last_assignment_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest 'assigned' story timestamp; null if never assigned
      - name: last_modification_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest story timestamp across all actions; null if no stories
      - name: completion_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest 'completed' story timestamp; required when is_completed and completed_at is null
      - name: hours_to_assignment
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Hours from task.created_at to first_assignment_timestamp; null if never assigned
      - name: hours_assigned_to_completion
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Hours from first_assignment_timestamp to task.completed_at; null if either timestamp is missing
      - name: total_lifecycle_hours
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Hours from task.created_at to task.completed_at, or to the current time if not completed
      - name: total_story_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of all stories with non-null action_taken for the task
      - name: unique_action_types
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of action_taken values across stories for the task
      - name: days_with_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of calendar dates with any story activity
      - name: avg_daily_activity_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average stories per day across the lifecycle; rounded to 2 decimals when lifecycle days > 0, else equals total_story_events
      - name: lifecycle_efficiency_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Efficiency class based on completion status, hours_to_assignment, hours_assigned_to_completion, total_lifecycle_hours, and urgency_score using ordered rules
      - name: activity_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Activity class from avg_daily_activity_rate thresholds: very_active, active, moderate_activity, low_activity, dormant'
      - name: lifecycle_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Overall lifecycle score clamped to [0,100] from timeliness, response speed, activity_score*4, and complexity adaptation
      - name: current_lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Stage label from ordered rules: backlog, newly_assigned, active_development, stagnant, completed_on_time, completed_delayed, or unknown_state'
      - name: anomaly_patterns
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma+space separated anomaly tokens in fixed order with trimming; empty string if none
      - name: success_patterns
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma+space separated success tokens in fixed order with trimming; empty string if none
      - name: improvement_opportunities
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma+space separated improvement tokens in fixed order with trimming; empty string if none
      - name: complexity_execution_match
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Execution speed vs complexity classification with first-match priority: appropriate_simple/medium/complex, faster_than_expected, slower_than_expected, within_range'
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project name from stg_asana__project via project membership; null when no project
      - name: team_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Team ID from the associated project; null when no project
      - name: project_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Project overall health score (default 50 when project exists but no indicator); null when no project membership
      - name: assignee_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee user_name from stg_asana__user using the casted assignee_user_id join; null if no match
      - name: assignee_performance_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee performance grade from user context; set to 'unknown' for any matched user by design
      - name: relative_performance_vs_project
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Relative class vs project_health_score: above_project_average, slightly_above_average, project_average, slightly_below_average, below_project_average (null project treated as below_project_average)'
      - name: is_valid_record
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if all data quality checks pass; the final result set filters to is_valid_record=true

WITH story_agg AS (SELECT target_task_id,MIN(created_at) FILTER(WHERE action_taken='created') creation_timestamp,MIN(created_at) FILTER(WHERE action_taken='assigned') first_assignment_timestamp,MAX(created_at) FILTER(WHERE action_taken='assigned') last_assignment_timestamp,MAX(created_at) last_modification_timestamp,MIN(created_at) FILTER(WHERE action_taken='completed') completion_timestamp,COUNT(*)::BIGINT total_story_events,COUNT(DISTINCT action_taken)::BIGINT unique_action_types,COUNT(DISTINCT created_at::DATE)::BIGINT days_with_activity FROM intermediate.int_asana__task_story WHERE action_taken IS NOT NULL GROUP BY target_task_id),
base AS (SELECT t.*,m.task_status_category,m.performance_grade,m.health_score,m.response_time_days,m.delay_days,m.complexity_score,m.urgency_score,m.activity_score,s.creation_timestamp,s.first_assignment_timestamp,s.last_assignment_timestamp,s.last_modification_timestamp,s.completion_timestamp,COALESCE(s.total_story_events,0)::BIGINT total_story_events,COALESCE(s.unique_action_types,0)::BIGINT unique_action_types,COALESCE(s.days_with_activity,0)::BIGINT days_with_activity,
 DATE_DIFF('hour',t.created_at,s.first_assignment_timestamp)::BIGINT hours_to_assignment,DATE_DIFF('hour',s.first_assignment_timestamp,t.completed_at)::BIGINT hours_assigned_to_completion,DATE_DIFF('hour',t.created_at,COALESCE(t.completed_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))::BIGINT total_lifecycle_hours,
 CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',t.created_at,COALESCE(t.completed_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))>0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(s.total_story_events,0)::DOUBLE/DATE_DIFF('day',t.created_at,COALESCE(t.completed_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)),2) ELSE COALESCE(s.total_story_events,0)::DOUBLE END avg_daily_activity_rate
FROM staging.stg_asana__task t LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics m ON t.task_id=m.task_id LEFT JOIN story_agg s ON t.task_id=s.target_task_id WHERE t.created_at IS NOT NULL),
calc AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN is_completed THEN CASE WHEN hours_to_assignment<=24 AND hours_assigned_to_completion<=168 THEN 'highly_efficient' WHEN hours_to_assignment<=72 AND hours_assigned_to_completion<=336 THEN 'efficient' WHEN hours_to_assignment<=168 AND hours_assigned_to_completion<=720 THEN 'moderate' WHEN hours_to_assignment<=336 THEN 'slow_start' WHEN hours_assigned_to_completion>720 THEN 'slow_completion' ELSE 'inefficient' END WHEN hours_to_assignment IS NULL AND total_lifecycle_hours>168 THEN 'stalled_unassigned' WHEN hours_to_assignment IS NOT NULL AND total_lifecycle_hours>720 THEN 'stalled_assigned' WHEN urgency_score>=4 AND total_lifecycle_hours>72 THEN 'urgent_delayed' ELSE 'in_progress' END lifecycle_efficiency_category,
CASE WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate>=2 THEN 'very_active' WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate>=1 THEN 'active' WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate>=.5 THEN 'moderate_activity' WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate>=.1 THEN 'low_activity' ELSE 'dormant' END activity_level,
LEAST(100,GREATEST(0,(CASE WHEN is_completed AND delay_days=0 THEN 40 WHEN is_completed AND delay_days<=2 THEN 30 WHEN is_completed AND delay_days<=7 THEN 20 WHEN is_completed THEN 10 WHEN due_date::DATE>CURRENT_DATE THEN 35 WHEN due_date::DATE=CURRENT_DATE THEN 25 ELSE 5 END)+(CASE WHEN response_time_days<=1 THEN 30 WHEN response_time_days<=3 THEN 25 WHEN response_time_days<=7 THEN 20 WHEN response_time_days<=14 THEN 15 WHEN response_time_days IS NOT NULL THEN 10 ELSE 5 END)+COALESCE(activity_score,1)*4+(CASE WHEN complexity_score=1 AND total_lifecycle_hours<=168 THEN 10 WHEN complexity_score=2 AND total_lifecycle_hours<=336 THEN 10 WHEN complexity_score=3 AND total_lifecycle_hours<=720 THEN 10 WHEN total_lifecycle_hours<=72 THEN 8 ELSE 5 END)))::INTEGER lifecycle_health_score,
CASE WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NULL THEN 'backlog' WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(first_assignment_timestamp,created_at)>=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-INTERVAL '1 day' THEN 'newly_assigned' WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL AND modified_at>=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-INTERVAL '7 day' THEN 'active_development' WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'stagnant' WHEN is_completed AND delay_days=0 THEN 'completed_on_time' WHEN is_completed AND delay_days>0 THEN 'completed_delayed' ELSE 'unknown_state' END current_lifecycle_stage
FROM base), context AS (SELECT c.*,p.project_name,p.team_id,CASE WHEN p.project_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(h.overall_health_score,50) END::INTEGER project_health_score,u.user_name assignee_name,CASE WHEN u.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'unknown' END assignee_performance_grade
FROM calc c LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__project_task pt ON c.task_id=pt.task_id::VARCHAR LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__project p ON pt.project_id::VARCHAR=p.project_id LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators h ON p.project_id=h.project_id LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__user u ON c.assignee_user_id::VARCHAR=u.user_id),
final AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN project_health_score IS NULL THEN 'below_project_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score-project_health_score>20 THEN 'above_project_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score-project_health_score>10 THEN 'slightly_above_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score-project_health_score>=-10 THEN 'project_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score-project_health_score>=-20 THEN 'slightly_below_average' ELSE 'below_project_average' END relative_performance_vs_project,
concat_ws(', ',CASE WHEN hours_to_assignment>336 THEN 'delayed_assignment' END,CASE WHEN hours_assigned_to_completion>1440 THEN 'prolonged_execution' END,CASE WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate<.1 AND NOT is_completed THEN 'dormant_task' END,CASE WHEN complexity_score=1 AND total_lifecycle_hours>336 THEN 'overengineered_simple' END,CASE WHEN urgency_score>=4 AND response_time_days>3 THEN 'urgent_ignored' END,CASE WHEN parent_task_id IS NOT NULL AND total_lifecycle_hours>720 THEN 'blocked_subtask' END,CASE WHEN delay_days>14 THEN 'severely_delayed' END,CASE WHEN total_story_events>50 THEN 'high_churn' END) anomaly_patterns,
concat_ws(', ',CASE WHEN lifecycle_efficiency_category='highly_efficient' THEN 'fast_track' END,CASE WHEN is_completed AND delay_days=0 AND performance_grade='excellent' THEN 'exemplary_execution' END,CASE WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate>=1 AND is_completed THEN 'consistent_progress' END,CASE WHEN response_time_days<=1 AND hours_assigned_to_completion<=168 THEN 'rapid_delivery' END,CASE WHEN complexity_score=3 AND lifecycle_health_score>=80 THEN 'complex_mastery' END,CASE WHEN urgency_score>=4 AND delay_days=0 THEN 'urgent_success' END) success_patterns,
concat_ws(', ',CASE WHEN hours_to_assignment>72 THEN 'faster_assignment' END,CASE WHEN activity_level IN ('low_activity','dormant') THEN 'increase_engagement' END,CASE WHEN delay_days>0 THEN 'improve_time_management' END,CASE WHEN response_time_days>3 THEN 'enhance_responsiveness' END,CASE WHEN lifecycle_health_score<60 THEN 'overall_process_improvement' END,CASE WHEN total_story_events<3 AND NOT is_completed THEN 'add_progress_updates' END) improvement_opportunities,
CASE WHEN complexity_score=1 AND total_lifecycle_hours<=72 THEN 'appropriate_simple' WHEN complexity_score=2 AND total_lifecycle_hours BETWEEN 73 AND 336 THEN 'appropriate_medium' WHEN complexity_score=3 AND total_lifecycle_hours BETWEEN 337 AND 720 THEN 'appropriate_complex' WHEN total_lifecycle_hours<complexity_score*72 THEN 'faster_than_expected' WHEN total_lifecycle_hours>complexity_score*240 THEN 'slower_than_expected' ELSE 'within_range' END complexity_execution_match,
(task_id IS NOT NULL AND task_name IS NOT NULL AND lifecycle_health_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND total_lifecycle_hours>=0 AND (hours_to_assignment IS NULL OR hours_to_assignment>=0) AND (hours_assigned_to_completion IS NULL OR hours_assigned_to_completion>=0) AND avg_daily_activity_rate>=0 AND NOT(is_completed AND completion_timestamp IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)) is_valid_record
FROM context)
SELECT task_id,task_name,created_at,completed_at,due_date,is_completed,assignee_user_id,parent_task_id,task_status_category,performance_grade,health_score,response_time_days,delay_days,complexity_score,urgency_score,activity_score,creation_timestamp,first_assignment_timestamp,last_assignment_timestamp,last_modification_timestamp,completion_timestamp,hours_to_assignment,hours_assigned_to_completion,total_lifecycle_hours,total_story_events,unique_action_types,days_with_activity,avg_daily_activity_rate,lifecycle_efficiency_category,activity_level,lifecycle_health_score,current_lifecycle_stage,anomaly_patterns,success_patterns,improvement_opportunities,complexity_execution_match,project_name,team_id,project_health_score,assignee_name,assignee_performance_grade,relative_performance_vs_project,is_valid_record
FROM final WHERE is_valid_record ORDER BY lifecycle_health_score DESC,total_lifecycle_hours,task_id
