COALESCE(s.days_with_activity,0)
AND avg_daily_activity_rate>=0 AND

WITH story_agg AS (SELECT target_task_id,MIN(created_at) FILTER(WHERE action_taken='created') creation_timestamp,MIN(created_at) FILTER(WHERE action_taken='assigned') first_assignment_timestamp,MAX(created_at) FILTER(WHERE action_taken='assigned') last_assignment_timestamp,MAX(created_at) last_modification_timestamp,MIN(created_at) FILTER(WHERE action_taken='completed') completion_timestamp,COUNT(*)::BIGINT total_story_events,COUNT(DISTINCT action_taken)::BIGINT unique_action_types,COUNT(DISTINCT created_at::DATE)::BIGINT days_with_activity FROM intermediate.int_asana__task_story WHERE action_taken IS NOT NULL GROUP BY target_task_id),
base AS (SELECT t.*,m.task_status_category,m.performance_grade,m.health_score,m.response_time_days,m.delay_days,m.complexity_score,m.urgency_score,m.activity_score,s.creation_timestamp,s.first_assignment_timestamp,s.last_assignment_timestamp,s.last_modification_timestamp,s.completion_timestamp,COALESCE(s.total_story_events,0)::BIGINT total_story_events,COALESCE(s.unique_action_types,0)::BIGINT unique_action_types,COALESCE(s.days_with_activity,0)::BIGINT days_with_activity,
 DATE_DIFF('hour',t.created_at,s.first_assignment_timestamp)::BIGINT hours_to_assignment,DATE_DIFF('hour',s.first_assignment_timestamp,t.completed_at)::BIGINT hours_assigned_to_completion,DATE_DIFF('hour',t.created_at,COALESCE(t.completed_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))::BIGINT total_lifecycle_hours,
 CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',t.created_at,COALESCE(t.completed_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))>0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(s.total_story_events,0)::DOUBLE/DATE_DIFF('day',t.created_at,COALESCE(t.completed_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)),2) ELSE COALESCE(s.total_story_events,0)::DOUBLE END avg_daily_activity_rate
FROM staging.stg_asana__task t LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics m ON t.task_id=m.task_id LEFT JOIN story_agg s ON t.task_id=s.target_task_id WHERE t.created_at IS NOT NULL),
calc AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN is_completed THEN CASE WHEN hours_to_assignment<=24 AND hours_assigned_to_completion<=168 THEN 'highly_efficient' WHEN hours_to_assignment<=72 AND hours_assigned_to_completion<=336 THEN 'efficient' WHEN hours_to_assignment<=168 AND hours_assigned_to_completion<=720 THEN 'moderate' WHEN hours_to_assignment<=336 THEN 'slow_start' WHEN hours_assigned_to_completion>720 THEN 'slow_completion' ELSE 'inefficient' END WHEN hours_to_assignment IS NULL AND total_lifecycle_hours>168 THEN 'stalled_unassigned' WHEN hours_to_assignment IS NOT NULL AND total_lifecycle_hours>720 THEN 'stalled_assigned' WHEN urgency_score>=4 AND total_lifecycle_hours>72 THEN 'urgent_delayed' ELSE 'in_progress' END lifecycle_efficiency_category,
CASE WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate>=2 THEN 'very_active' WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate>=1 THEN 'active' WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate>=.5 THEN 'moderate_activity' WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate>=.1 THEN 'low_activity' ELSE 'dormant' END activity_level,
LEAST(100,GREATEST(0,(CASE WHEN is_completed AND delay_days=0 THEN 40 WHEN is_completed AND delay_days<=2 THEN 30 WHEN is_completed AND delay_days<=7 THEN 20 WHEN is_completed THEN 10 WHEN due_date::DATE>CURRENT_DATE THEN 35 WHEN due_date::DATE=CURRENT_DATE THEN 25 ELSE 5 END)+(CASE WHEN response_time_days<=1 THEN 30 WHEN response_time_days<=3 THEN 25 WHEN response_time_days<=7 THEN 20 WHEN response_time_days<=14 THEN 15 WHEN response_time_days IS NOT NULL THEN 10 ELSE 5 END)+COALESCE(activity_score,1)*4+(CASE WHEN complexity_score=1 AND total_lifecycle_hours<=168 THEN 10 WHEN complexity_score=2 AND total_lifecycle_hours<=336 THEN 10 WHEN complexity_score=3 AND total_lifecycle_hours<=720 THEN 10 WHEN total_lifecycle_hours<=72 THEN 8 ELSE 5 END)))::INTEGER lifecycle_health_score,
CASE WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NULL THEN 'backlog' WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(first_assignment_timestamp,created_at)>=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-INTERVAL '1 day' THEN 'newly_assigned' WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL AND modified_at>=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-INTERVAL '7 day' THEN 'active_development' WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'stagnant' WHEN is_completed AND delay_days=0 THEN 'completed_on_time' WHEN is_completed AND delay_days>0 THEN 'completed_delayed' ELSE 'unknown_state' END current_lifecycle_stage
FROM base), context AS (SELECT c.*,p.project_name,p.team_id,CASE WHEN p.project_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(h.overall_health_score,50) END::INTEGER project_health_score,u.user_name assignee_name,CASE WHEN u.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'unknown' END assignee_performance_grade
FROM calc c LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__project_task pt ON c.task_id=pt.task_id::VARCHAR LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__project p ON pt.project_id::VARCHAR=p.project_id LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators h ON p.project_id=h.project_id LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__user u ON c.assignee_user_id::VARCHAR=u.user_id),
final AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN project_health_score IS NULL THEN 'below_project_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score-project_health_score>20 THEN 'above_project_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score-project_health_score>10 THEN 'slightly_above_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score-project_health_score>=-10 THEN 'project_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score-project_health_score>=-20 THEN 'slightly_below_average' ELSE 'below_project_average' END relative_performance_vs_project,
concat_ws(', ',CASE WHEN hours_to_assignment>336 THEN 'delayed_assignment' END,CASE WHEN hours_assigned_to_completion>1440 THEN 'prolonged_execution' END,CASE WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate<.1 AND NOT is_completed THEN 'dormant_task' END,CASE WHEN complexity_score=1 AND total_lifecycle_hours>336 THEN 'overengineered_simple' END,CASE WHEN urgency_score>=4 AND response_time_days>3 THEN 'urgent_ignored' END,CASE WHEN parent_task_id IS NOT NULL AND total_lifecycle_hours>720 THEN 'blocked_subtask' END,CASE WHEN delay_days>14 THEN 'severely_delayed' END,CASE WHEN total_story_events>50 THEN 'high_churn' END) anomaly_patterns,
concat_ws(', ',CASE WHEN lifecycle_efficiency_category='highly_efficient' THEN 'fast_track' END,CASE WHEN is_completed AND delay_days=0 AND performance_grade='excellent' THEN 'exemplary_execution' END,CASE WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate>=1 AND is_completed THEN 'consistent_progress' END,CASE WHEN response_time_days<=1 AND hours_assigned_to_completion<=168 THEN 'rapid_delivery' END,CASE WHEN complexity_score=3 AND lifecycle_health_score>=80 THEN 'complex_mastery' END,CASE WHEN urgency_score>=4 AND delay_days=0 THEN 'urgent_success' END) success_patterns,
concat_ws(', ',CASE WHEN hours_to_assignment>72 THEN 'faster_assignment' END,CASE WHEN activity_level IN ('low_activity','dormant') THEN 'increase_engagement' END,CASE WHEN delay_days>0 THEN 'improve_time_management' END,CASE WHEN response_time_days>3 THEN 'enhance_responsiveness' END,CASE WHEN lifecycle_health_score<60 THEN 'overall_process_improvement' END,CASE WHEN total_story_events<3 AND NOT is_completed THEN 'add_progress_updates' END) improvement_opportunities,
CASE WHEN complexity_score=1 AND total_lifecycle_hours<=72 THEN 'appropriate_simple' WHEN complexity_score=2 AND total_lifecycle_hours BETWEEN 73 AND 336 THEN 'appropriate_medium' WHEN complexity_score=3 AND total_lifecycle_hours BETWEEN 337 AND 720 THEN 'appropriate_complex' WHEN total_lifecycle_hours<complexity_score*72 THEN 'faster_than_expected' WHEN total_lifecycle_hours>complexity_score*240 THEN 'slower_than_expected' ELSE 'within_range' END complexity_execution_match,
(task_id IS NOT NULL AND task_name IS NOT NULL AND lifecycle_health_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND total_lifecycle_hours>=0 AND (hours_to_assignment IS NULL OR hours_to_assignment>=0) AND (hours_assigned_to_completion IS NULL OR hours_assigned_to_completion>=0) AND avg_daily_activity_rate>=0 AND NOT(is_completed AND completion_timestamp IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)) is_valid_record
FROM context)
SELECT task_id,task_name,created_at,completed_at,due_date,is_completed,assignee_user_id,parent_task_id,task_status_category,performance_grade,health_score,response_time_days,delay_days,complexity_score,urgency_score,activity_score,creation_timestamp,first_assignment_timestamp,last_assignment_timestamp,last_modification_timestamp,completion_timestamp,hours_to_assignment,hours_assigned_to_completion,total_lifecycle_hours,total_story_events,unique_action_types,days_with_activity,avg_daily_activity_rate,lifecycle_efficiency_category,activity_level,lifecycle_health_score,current_lifecycle_stage,anomaly_patterns,success_patterns,improvement_opportunities,complexity_execution_match,project_name,team_id,project_health_score,assignee_name,assignee_performance_grade,relative_performance_vs_project,is_valid_record
FROM final WHERE is_valid_record ORDER BY lifecycle_health_score DESC,total_lifecycle_hours,task_id

- name: asana__team_efficiency_metrics
      description: Team-level efficiency, performance, schedule, quality metrics, classifications, and ranks computed from Asana teams, projects, tasks, and users
      grain: One validated row per (team_id, team_name)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__team
      - staging.stg_asana__project
      - intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators
      - staging.stg_asana__project_task
      - staging.stg_asana__task
      - staging.stg_asana__user
      business_logic: '- Inputs and filters: - team_base: teams with non-null team_name. - project_base: projects with non-null team_id. - project_health_summary: project health fields with project_size_category defaulted to ''medium_project'' and schedule_forecast sourced from project_forecast. - user_basic_metrics: users with defaults performance_grade=''developing_performer'', workload_category=''normal_workload'', anomaly_flag=''normal'', risk_level=''low_risk'', portfolio_task_count=0, portfolio_overdue_tasks=0. - team_project_summary (per team_id, team_name; projects linked to health by project_id): - Project counts: - total_projects: number of unique projects. - active_projects: unique projects where project_status=''active''; projects without health data are not counted. - completed_projects: unique projects with completion_percentage=100. - overdue_projects: unique projects forecasted ''overdue''. - Averages over health fields (NULLs are ignored; result is NULL when no non-NULL values exist): - avg_project_health and avg_project_performance from overall_health_score. - avg_completion_rate from completion_percentage. - avg_quality_rate from quality_percentage. - avg_risk_percentage from risk_percentage. - Project size distribution: counts of projects by project_size_category among those with health data. - Defaults: total_team_tasks=0, completed_team_tasks=0, active_team_tasks=0, overdue_team_tasks=0, total_project_assignments=0, avg_tasks_per_assignee_across_projects=0.0, avg_project_velocity=0.5, avg_estimated_completion_days=30.0. - Percent metrics: - on_schedule_rate_pct: for teams with at least one unique project, percentage of unique projects forecasted ''on_schedule'', rounded to 2 decimals; otherwise 0. - quality_completion_rate_pct: for teams with at least one unique completed project, percentage of unique completed projects with overall_health_score>=80, rounded to 2 decimals; otherwise 0. - team_member_performance (per team via projects → project_task → task; only tasks with non-null assignee; users linked by assignee_user_id=user_id): - unique_team_members: number of distinct assignees. - Defaults: avg_member_performance=50.0, avg_member_completion_rate=75.0, avg_member_quality_rate=70.0. - Distributions (counts across task rows; a member appearing on multiple tasks is counted multiple times): top/high/solid/developing/underperformers by performance_grade; high_workload_members by workload_category=''high_workload''; high_risk_members by risk_level=''high_risk''. - avg_tasks_per_member: average of portfolio_task_count over joined task rows; NULL when no rows. - team_efficiency_scoring (join by team_id): - project_management_score (0–25): from on_schedule_rate_pct thresholds (>=90→25, >=75→20, >=60→15, >=40→10, else 5), capped to [0,25]. - quality_management_score (0–25): from avg_quality_rate thresholds (>=85→25, >=70→20, >=55→15, >=40→10, else 5), capped to [0,25]. - collaboration_efficiency_score (0–25): if unique_team_members>0 then based on performer mix shares ((top+high), then (top+high+solid), then underperformers); else 0; capped to [0,25]. - resource_optimization_score (0–25): if unique_team_members>0 then based on shares of high_workload_members and high_risk_members; else 0; capped to [0,25]. - final_team_metrics: - overall_team_efficiency_score: sum of the four sub-scores (0–100). - efficiency_grade: thresholds on overall_team_efficiency_score (>=85 highly_efficient, >=70 efficient, >=55 moderately_efficient, >=40 needs_improvement, else inefficient). - team_size_category: by unique_team_members (<=3 small_team, <=8 medium_team, <=15 large_team, else enterprise_team). - workload_balance_status: by share of high_workload_members (<=10% well_balanced, <=25% mostly_balanced, <=50% unbalanced, else severely_unbalanced); ''no_data'' when no members. - team_maturity_level: by performer mix shares ((top+high) then (top+high+solid) then underperformers); ''undefined'' when no members. - improvement_recommendations: phrases appended in fixed order when conditions are met, then trailing comma/space removed; empty when none. - team_strengths: phrases appended in fixed order when conditions are met, then trailing comma/space removed; empty when none. - validated_team_metrics: - is_valid_record: true only when team_id and team_name are present; overall_team_efficiency_score, avg_completion_rate, avg_quality_rate are within [0,100]; total_projects, completed_projects are non-negative; completed_projects does not exceed total_projects; unique_team_members is non-negative. - Ranks: efficiency_rank by overall_team_efficiency_score descending; performance_rank by avg_project_performance descending; schedule_reliability_rank by on_schedule_rate_pct descending; quality_rank by avg_quality_rate descending; ranks computed before filtering invalid rows. - Output: only rows with is_valid_record=true; ordered by overall_team_efficiency_score descending, then team_id.'
      columns:
      - name: team_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Team identifier; exactly one output row per (team_id, team_name) after validation
      - name: team_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Team display name; non-null due to initial filter
      - name: total_projects
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique projects for the team; unaffected by health join; 0 when none

      - name: avg_risk_percentage

        description: Average risk percentage (0–100) across projects with health data; NULL when none
      - name: enterprise_projects

        description: Projects with size 'enterprise_project' among those with health data
      - name: large_projects
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Projects with size 'large_project' among those with health data
      - name: medium_projects
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Projects with size 'medium_project' among those with health data
      - name: small_projects
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Projects with size 'small_project' among those with health data
      - name: total_team_tasks
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Constant 0
      - name: completed_team_tasks
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Constant 0
      - name: active_team_tasks
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Constant 0
      - name: overdue_team_tasks
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Constant 0
      - name: total_project_assignments
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Constant 0
      - name: avg_tasks_per_assignee_across_projects
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: Constant 0.0
      - name: avg_project_velocity
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: Constant 0.5
      - name: avg_estimated_completion_days
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Constant 30.0
      - name: on_schedule_rate_pct

      - name: unique_team_members

      - name: avg_member_performance
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Constant 50.0
      - name: avg_member_completion_rate
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Constant 75.0
      - name: avg_member_quality_rate
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Constant 70.0
      - name: top_performers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Task rows where user grade is 'top_performer'; duplicates by user across tasks are kept
      - name: high_performers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Task rows where user grade is 'high_performer'; duplicates by user across tasks are kept
      - name: solid_performers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Task rows where user grade is 'solid_performer'; duplicates by user across tasks are kept
      - name: developing_performers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Task rows where user grade is 'developing_performer'; duplicates by user across tasks are kept
      - name: underperformers

      - name: high_workload_members
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Task rows with user workload 'high_workload'; duplicates kept
      - name: high_risk_members
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Task rows with user risk 'high_risk'; duplicates kept
      - name: avg_tasks_per_member
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of user portfolio_task_count over joined task rows; typically 0 due to defaults; NULL when no rows
      - name: project_management_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 score from on_schedule_rate_pct thresholds (>=90→25, >=75→20, >=60→15, >=40→10, else 5), capped to [0,25]
      - name: quality_management_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 score from avg_quality_rate thresholds (>=85→25, >=70→20, >=55→15, >=40→10, else 5), capped to [0,25]
      - name: collaboration_efficiency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 score from performer mix among unique_team_members; 0 when no members; capped to [0,25]
      - name: resource_optimization_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 score from high_workload and high_risk member shares; 0 when no members; capped to [0,25]
      - name: overall_team_efficiency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of the four sub-scores in [0,100]
      - name: efficiency_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Label from overall_team_efficiency_score: >=85 highly_efficient, >=70 efficient, >=55 moderately_efficient, >=40 needs_improvement, else inefficient'
      - name: team_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Size by unique_team_members: <=3 small_team, <=8 medium_team, <=15 large_team, else enterprise_team'
      - name: workload_balance_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Balance by share of high_workload members: <=10% well_balanced, <=25% mostly_balanced, <=50% unbalanced, else severely_unbalanced; ''no_data'' when no members'
      - name: team_maturity_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Maturity by performer mix: >=60% top+high mature_team; else >=70% top+high+solid developing_team; else underperformers<=30% mixed_maturity; else needs_development; ''undefined'' when no members'
      - name: improvement_recommendations
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated suggestions built in fixed order and trimmed; empty when none
      - name: team_strengths
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated strengths built in fixed order and trimmed; empty when none
      - name: is_valid_record
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: 'True only if IDs present and metrics within bounds: overall_team_efficiency_score, avg_completion_rate, avg_quality_rate in [0,100]; total_projects, completed_projects non-negative with completed_projects<=total_projects; unique_team_members non-negative; else false'
      - name: efficiency_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank over all teams by overall_team_efficiency_score descending (ties share rank); computed before filtering invalid rows
      - name: performance_rank

        description: Rank over all teams by avg_project_performance descending (ties share rank); computed before filtering invalid rows
      - name: schedule_reliability_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank over all teams by on_schedule_rate_pct descending (ties share rank); computed before filtering invalid rows
      - name: quality_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank over all teams by avg_quality_rate descending (ties share rank); computed before filtering invalid rows

WITH teams AS (SELECT * FROM staging.stg_asana__team WHERE team_name IS NOT NULL),

 ROUND(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT p.project_id) FILTER(WHERE h.project_forecast='on_schedule')/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.project_id),0),2) on_schedule_rate_pct,ROUND(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT p.project_id) FILTER(WHERE h.completion_percentage=100 AND h.overall_health_score>=80)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.project_id) FILTER(WHERE h.completion_percentage=100),0),2) quality_completion_rate_pct

- name: stg_asana__section
      description: "Standardized project sections for organizing tasks with validated project relationships"
      source_table: "raw.section_data"
      columns:
        - name: section_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null, unique]
        - name: created_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          constraints: [not_null]
        - name: section_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "section_name = TRIM(section_name)"
              on_failure: correct
              description: "Remove whitespace from section names"
            - rule: "LENGTH(section_name) >= 1"
              on_failure: delete_row
              description: "Section name cannot be empty"

    SELECT id::VARCHAR section_id, CAST(TRY_STRPTIME(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f %z') AS TIMESTAMP) created_at, TRIM(name) section_name, TRY_CAST(project_id AS BIGINT) project_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY id) AS _rn

)
SELECT * EXCLUDE (_rn)

WHERE _rn = 1

- name: int_google_play__app_quality_metrics
      description: Daily Google Play app stability and quality metrics per package (crashes, ANRs, rates, rolling averages, fragmentation, scoring, trend, category, and risk)
      grain: One row per package_name per date_day (driven by crashes_overview)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_crashes_overview
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_crashes_app_version
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_crashes_os_version
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_installs_overview
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_ratings_overview
      business_logic: '- Filter sources to valid ranges: - crashes_overview, crashes_by_version, crashes_by_os: keep rows with crashes >= 0 and ANRs >= 0. - installs_overview: keep rows with daily_device_installs >= 0 and active_device_installs >= 0. - ratings_overview: keep rows with daily_average_rating and total_average_rating between 1.0 and 5.0. - Build stability_metrics per (package_name, date_day) from crashes_overview: - Left join installs_overview and ratings_overview by (date_day, package_name). - crash_rate_per_1k_devices: daily_crashes divided by active_device_installs, scaled to per 1,000 devices, rounded to 4 decimals; only when active_device_installs > 0, otherwise NULL. - anr_rate_per_1k_devices: daily_anrs divided by active_device_installs, scaled to per 1,000 devices, rounded to 4 decimals; only when active_device_installs > 0, otherwise NULL. - total_stability_issues = daily_crashes + daily_anrs. - Rolling 7-day averages per package_name ordered by date_day using a window that includes the current day and up to the prior 6 days: - avg_7d_crashes and avg_7d_anrs average the available daily values; inputs are non-NULL so these averages are defined. - avg_7d_rating averages available non-NULL ratings; returns NULL when no ratings exist in the window. - Version fragmentation: - active_versions_count: count distinct app_version_code from crashes_by_version per (date_day, package_name); NULL when no version data exists. - version_with_most_crashes: select the app_version_code with the highest sum of crashes + ANRs on that day; ties follow default engine ordering; associated crashes and ANRs are reported. - OS fragmentation: - supported_os_versions: count distinct android_os_version from crashes_by_os per (date_day, package_name); NULL when no OS data exists. - os_with_most_crashes: select the OS version with the highest sum of crashes + ANRs on that day; ties follow default engine ordering; associated crashes and ANRs are reported. - Quality scoring: - If daily_average_rating is NULL, quality_score is NULL. Otherwise compute points: - Rating: (daily_average_rating / 5) × 40. - Crash rate: 30 points if ≤1, 20 if ≤5, 10 if ≤10, else 0; NULL rate contributes 0. - ANR rate: 20 points if ≤1, 15 if ≤5, 10 if ≤10, else 0; NULL rate contributes 0. - Version fragmentation: 10 points if active_versions_count ≤3, 5 if ≤5, else 0; NULL contributes 0. - Sum points, clamp at a minimum of 0, and round to 2 decimals to produce quality_score. - Stability trend: - Compare avg_7d_crashes to the value 7 days earlier within the same package: if lower → Improving; if higher → Degrading; otherwise → Stable. If the prior value is missing, treat as Stable. - Final output: - Round avg_7d_crashes, avg_7d_anrs, avg_7d_rating to 2 decimals. - quality_category: Excellent (≥80), Good (≥65), Fair (≥50), Poor (≥35), Critical (<35 when not NULL), Unrated (NULL score). - stability_risk_level: High Risk if crash rate >20 or ANR rate >15; Medium Risk if >10 or >8; Low Risk if >5 or >3; otherwise Minimal Risk. NULL rates do not trigger thresholds. - Emit one row per (package_name, date_day) and remove rows where either key is NULL.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Metric date (UTC); exactly one output row per package_name per date_day
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: package_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Play package identifier; grouping key with date_day
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: daily_crashes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of crashes on date_day from crashes_overview; source rows require crashes >= 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: daily_anrs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of ANRs on date_day from crashes_overview; source rows require anrs >= 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_stability_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Sum of daily_crashes + daily_anrs for the day; always >= 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: crash_rate_per_1k_devices
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily crashes per 1,000 active devices; computed only when active_device_installs > 0; rounded to 4 decimals; else NULL
        tests: []
      - name: anr_rate_per_1k_devices
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily ANRs per 1,000 active devices; computed only when active_device_installs > 0; rounded to 4 decimals; else NULL
        tests: []
      - name: avg_7d_crashes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7-day rolling average of daily_crashes per package_name ordered by date_day (current day plus up to 6 prior days); rounded to 2 decimals; never NULL
        tests: []
      - name: avg_7d_anrs
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7-day rolling average of daily_anrs per package_name ordered by date_day (current day plus up to 6 prior days); rounded to 2 decimals; never NULL
        tests: []
      - name: avg_7d_rating
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7-day rolling average of daily_average_rating using non-NULL values only; NULL if window has no ratings; rounded to 2 decimals
        tests: []
      - name: active_versions_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct app_version_code with non-negative metrics on date_day; NULL if no version data
        tests: []
      - name: version_with_most_crashes
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: App version_code with highest total of crashes + ANRs on date_day; ties resolved by engine-default order; NULL if no version data
        tests: []
      - name: worst_version_crashes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Crashes for version_with_most_crashes on date_day; NULL if no version selected
        tests: []
      - name: worst_version_anrs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: ANRs for version_with_most_crashes on date_day; NULL if no version selected
        tests: []
      - name: supported_os_versions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct android_os_version with non-negative metrics on date_day; NULL if no OS data
        tests: []
      - name: os_with_most_crashes
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Android OS version with highest total of crashes + ANRs on date_day; ties resolved by engine-default order; NULL if no OS data
        tests: []
      - name: worst_os_crashes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Crashes for os_with_most_crashes on date_day; NULL if no OS selected
        tests: []
      - name: worst_os_anrs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: ANRs for os_with_most_crashes on date_day; NULL if no OS selected
        tests: []
      - name: quality_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Weighted score (0–100) combining rating (40%), crash rate (30%), ANR rate (20%), and version fragmentation (10); NULL rates or counts contribute 0; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if daily_average_rating is NULL
        tests: []
      - name: stability_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend vs the value 7 days earlier using avg_7d_crashes: Improving if lower, Degrading if higher, else Stable; missing prior value treated as Stable'
        tests:
        - not_null
        - in_set('Improving','Degrading','Stable')
      - name: quality_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Category from quality_score: Excellent (≥80), Good (≥65), Fair (≥50), Poor (≥35), Critical (<35 and not NULL), Unrated (quality_score NULL)'
        tests:
        - not_null
        - in_set('Excellent','Good','Fair','Poor','Critical','Unrated')
      - name: stability_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk from crash/anr rates: High Risk (>20 or >15), Medium Risk (>10 or >8), Low Risk (>5 or >3), else Minimal Risk; NULL rates do not trigger thresholds'
        tests:
        - not_null
        - in_set('High Risk','Medium Risk','Low Risk','Minimal Risk')

- name: google_play__app_version_report
      description: App version performance by date with installs, uninstalls, crashes/ANRs, ratings, and cumulative metrics per OS version and device
      grain: One row per date_day, package_name, app_version_code, android_os_version, device
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_installs_app_version
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_crashes_app_version
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_ratings_app_version
      business_logic: '- Inputs: - Installs: per date, package, app_version_code, android_os_version, device - Ratings: per date, package, app_version_code - Crashes: per date, package, app_version_code, android_os_version - Compute cumulative install totals on the installs input: - total_device_installs: cumulative sum of daily_device_installs by date_day ascending within (package_name, app_version_code) - total_device_uninstalls: cumulative sum of daily_device_uninstalls by date_day ascending within (package_name, app_version_code) - Note: ordering is by date_day only; if multiple rows share the same date_day, the physical/source row order determines evaluation within that day; device and android_os_version are not included in the partition. - Full outer join to unify datasets: - First join installs with ratings on (date_day, package_name, app_version_code) using null-safe comparison by substituting NULL app_version_code with ''null_version'' - Then join crashes on the available date from installs or ratings, plus (package_name, app_version_code, android_os_version), using null-safe comparison by substituting NULL app_version_code with ''null_version'' and NULL android_os_version with ''null_os''; android_os_version is compared as a string; device is not part of any join key. - Output dimensions: - date_day, app_version_code, package_name selected from installs if present, else ratings, else crashes - android_os_version from installs if present else crashes (as string) - device from installs only (NULL if the row originates only from ratings/crashes) - Populate metrics with deterministic null handling: - From installs: active_device_installs → active_devices_last_30_days; all daily device/user/event metrics treat missing values as 0 - From crashes: crashes and anrs treat missing values as 0; values repeat across devices because device is not joined - From ratings: average_rating is the daily average rating (NULL if missing); rolling_total_average_rating is the total-average rating (may be NULL) - Forward-fill selected metrics across dates within (package_name, app_version_code): - For rolling_total_average_rating and each cumulative total, create a segment identifier as the running count of non-NULL values by date_day ascending - Within each segment, carry forward the first observed non-NULL value to subsequent rows; values remain NULL until the first non-NULL appears - Finalize outputs: - total_device_installs and total_device_uninstalls are treated as 0 when still missing after forward-fill - net_device_installs = total_device_installs − total_device_uninstalls - No aggregation or de-duplication beyond the joins; duplicates from sources are preserved; original string casing and spacing are preserved'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Selected from installs if present, else ratings, else crashes
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_version_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Taken from whichever source is present; may be NULL; joins substitute NULL with 'null_version'
      - name: package_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Play package identifier selected from the available source
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: android_os_version
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Android OS version from installs else crashes, compared as strings with 'null_os' used when missing
      - name: device
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Device identifier from installs; NULL when only ratings/crashes data exists
      - name: device_installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device installs from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: device_uninstalls
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device uninstalls from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: device_upgrades
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device upgrades from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: user_installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily user installs from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: user_uninstalls
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily user uninstalls from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: install_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily install event count from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: uninstall_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily uninstall event count from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: update_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily update event count from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: crashes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily crash count joined by date/package/version/OS; missing values become 0 and values repeat across devices
      - name: anrs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily ANR count joined by date/package/version/OS; missing values become 0 and values repeat across devices
      - name: active_devices_last_30_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Active devices in the last 30 days from installs; missing values become 0
      - name: average_rating
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Daily average rating from ratings; NULL if unavailable; range 1–5 when present
      - name: rolling_total_average_rating
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Total-average rating forward-filled by date within (package_name, app_version_code); NULL until the first non-NULL appears
      - name: total_device_installs
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Cumulative device installs by date within (package_name, app_version_code), forward-filled across gaps; missing values become 0; same-day tie order follows source row order
      - name: total_device_uninstalls
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Cumulative device uninstalls by date within (package_name, app_version_code), forward-filled across gaps; missing values become 0; same-day tie order follows source row order
      - name: net_device_installs
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total device installs minus total device uninstalls; may be negative; never NULL

- name: google_play__comprehensive_performance_dashboard
      description: Daily Google Play app performance combining installs, stability, engagement, retention, revenue, store conversion, risk, and recommended actions.
      grain: One or more rows per date_day and package_name (rows can repeat when multiple countries exist for the same day and app).
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_google_play__user_behavior_metrics
      - intermediate.int_google_play__revenue_analytics
      - intermediate.int_google_play__user_retention_analysis
      - mart.google_play__overview_report
      business_logic: 'Build user_behavior per date_day, package_name, and country by summing installs, uninstalls, and active devices, averaging churn and weekly installs, and counting distinct countries meeting engagement and growth conditions. Build revenue_performance per date_day and package_name by summing net revenue, transactions, and new subscriptions, averaging transaction value, refund rate, ARPU, and revenue health. Build retention_insights per package_name over the last 30 days by averaging day-1/7/30 retention and retention quality, and counting distinct countries with strong retention or high churn risk. Build overview_base per date_day and package_name by summing installs, uninstalls, crashes, ANRs, store acquisitions, and visitors, and averaging rating. Fully outer join these on date_day and package_name; for each metric, prefer overview_base where applicable, then user_behavior or revenue_performance, and default to 0 when unavailable (except conversion rate). Set default quality_score=75.0, crash_rate_per_1k=0.0, anr_rate_per_1k=0.0, and version_fragmentation=1. Compute store_conversion_rate only when visitors > 0 as acquisitions divided by visitors times 100, rounded to 2 decimals; otherwise NULL. Derive business_health_status with tiers: Thriving (installs > 2x uninstalls, quality >= 70, and revenue > 0), Healthy (installs > uninstalls, quality >= 50, and churn <= 0.10), Stable (installs >= uninstalls or quality >= 40), At Risk (quality >= 30), else Critical. Compute overall_performance_score (0–100) by adding points: installs activity (15 if installs > 0), quality (up to 20 by thresholds 80/60/40), rating (up to 15 by thresholds 4.5/4.0/3.5), retention via churn (up to 20 by thresholds 0.05/0.10/0.20), revenue (15 if revenue > 0), and store conversion (up to 15 by thresholds 5/2/1 percent); clamp to 0–100 and round to 2 decimals. Set growth_trend by comparing installs to the value 7 days earlier within the same package: Growing if higher, Declining if lower, else Stable (also Stable when no prior value). Compute install_uninstall_ratio as installs divided by uninstalls rounded to 2 decimals when uninstalls > 0; else NULL. Compute total_issues_per_1k_devices as (crashes + ANRs) per 1,000 active devices rounded to 2 decimals when active devices > 0; else NULL. Left join retention_insights by package_name so the same package-level 30-day averages apply to all dates. In the final output, round: quality_score to 1 decimal; average_rating to 2 decimals; crash and ANR rates per 1k to 2 decimals; daily_churn_rate to 4 decimals; day-1/7/30 retention to 1 decimal; daily_net_revenue to 2 decimals; avg_transaction_value to 2 decimals; refund_rate to 4 decimals; ARPU to 2 decimals; revenue_health_score to 1 decimal; overall_performance_score to 2 decimals; store_conversion_rate is already rounded to 2 decimals. Set primary_risk_flag with priority: Stability Risk (high crash/ANR rates), Retention Risk (high churn), Revenue Risk (high refunds), Performance Risk (low score), else Low Risk. Set recommended_action from the score: Optimize and Scale (>=80), Improve Quality (>=60), Focus on Retention (>=40), else Critical Review Required. Exclude rows where date_day or package_name is NULL and sort by date_day descending, then by overall_performance_score descending.'

- name: google_play__country_report
      description: Country-level performance metrics by package and day, joined across installs, ratings, and store performance and enriched with country metadata
      grain: One row per package_name per country_short per date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_installs_country
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_ratings_country
      - staging.stg_google_play__store_performance_country
      - staging.stg_google_play__country_codes
      business_logic: '- Load installs, ratings, store_performance, and country_codes staging tables. - From installs: compute running cumulative device installs and uninstalls per (country, package_name) across ascending dates. - From store_performance: compute running cumulative store listing installers and visitors per (country, package_name) across ascending dates. - Full outer join installs and ratings on matching date_day and package_name; match country null-safe by treating missing country codes as a shared placeholder so missing values match each other. - Full outer join store_performance to the combined result using the available date_day, package_name, and null-safe country from either side. - Build daily fields on the joined rows: - For daily counts (device_installs, device_uninstalls, device_upgrades, user_installs, user_uninstalls, install_events, uninstall_events, update_events, store_listing_acquisitions, store_listing_visitors, active_devices_last_30_days) replace missing values with 0. - Pass through store_listing_conversion_rate as provided (may be missing). - Pass through ratings.daily_average_rating and ratings.total_average_rating (may be missing). - Forward-fill cumulative totals and rolling_total_average_rating: - For each country and package, segment the timeline by each new non-missing occurrence of the cumulative field. - Within each segment, carry the most recently observed non-missing value forward to later days; values remain missing before the first observation. - Enrich with country metadata: - Left join country_codes on ISO alpha-2; set country_long to alternative name when available, otherwise the standard name; include region and sub_region. - Final computations: - Replace any remaining missing cumulative totals (device installs/uninstalls, store acquisitions/visitors) with 0. - rolling_store_conversion_rate = cumulative installers divided by cumulative visitors, rounded to 4 decimals; result is NULL when visitors is zero or missing. - net_device_installs = cumulative device installs minus cumulative device uninstalls.'

- name: google_play__finance_report
      description: Daily Google Play earnings and subscription activity, fully outer-joined and enriched with product and country metadata.
      grain: One row per (date_day, package_name, country_short, sku_id); source duplicates are preserved and may multiply across the join.
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_google_play__earnings
      - staging.stg_google_play__subscriptions_country
      - intermediate.int_google_play__latest_product_info
      - staging.stg_google_play__country_codes
      business_logic: 'Inputs: - Earnings: intermediate.int_google_play__earnings (monetary amounts and transaction counts, merchant_currency). - Subscriptions: staging.stg_google_play__subscriptions_country (new, cancelled, active by country). - Product metadata: intermediate.int_google_play__latest_product_info (title by package_name and sku_id). - Country metadata: staging.stg_google_play__country_codes (names, region, sub_region by ISO alpha-2). Steps: - Join earnings and subscriptions with a full outer join on date_day, package_name, SKU (earnings.sku_id = subscriptions.product_id), and country code; null country codes are treated as equal between the two sources for matching (a temporary placeholder is used only for join matching and never appears in outputs). - For each output row, choose identifiers as follows: - date_day: from earnings if present; otherwise from subscriptions. - country_short: from earnings if present; otherwise from subscriptions. - package_name: from earnings if present; otherwise from subscriptions. - sku_id: from earnings if present; otherwise from subscriptions. - merchant_currency: taken from earnings (subscriptions do not supply currency). - Metric null handling: - Earnings metrics (net_amount, transactions, charge_amount, charge_transactions, refund_amount, refund_transactions, other_amount, other_transactions): if missing, output 0; amounts use merchant_currency; signs are preserved; no additional rounding beyond source precision (3 decimal places). - Subscription flow metrics (new_subscriptions, cancelled_subscriptions): if missing, output 0. - Active subscriptions forward-fill: - For each (country_short, sku_id), sort rows by date_day ascending. - When a non-null active count appears, carry that value forward to later days until another non-null value replaces it. - Days before the first non-null active count remain unset during filling and are finally output as 0. - Enrichment: - Left join product metadata by (package_name, sku_id) to add product_title. - Left join country metadata by country_short to add country_long (alternative name when available, else standard name), region, and sub_region. - No aggregation or de-duplication is applied; output row order is not enforced.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Reporting date from earnings if present, otherwise from subscriptions; may be null.
      - name: country_short
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ISO alpha-2 country code from earnings if present, otherwise from subscriptions; may be null; used to join country metadata.
      - name: package_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Play package identifier from earnings if present, otherwise from subscriptions; may be null; used to join product metadata.
      - name: sku_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Product SKU from earnings if present, otherwise from subscriptions; may be null; used to join product metadata.
      - name: merchant_currency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Currency code sourced from earnings; may be null; unit for all amount columns.
      - name: net_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Net amount from earnings; missing values output as 0; uses merchant_currency; sign preserved.
      - name: transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total transaction count from earnings; missing values output as 0.
      - name: charge_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Charge amount from earnings; missing values output as 0; uses merchant_currency; sign preserved.
      - name: charge_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Charge transaction count from earnings; missing values output as 0.
      - name: refund_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Refund amount from earnings; missing values output as 0; uses merchant_currency; sign preserved.
      - name: refund_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Refund transaction count from earnings; missing values output as 0.
      - name: other_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Other amount from earnings; missing values output as 0; uses merchant_currency; sign preserved.
      - name: other_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Other transaction count from earnings; missing values output as 0.
      - name: new_subscriptions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: New subscriptions from the subscriptions source; missing values output as 0.
      - name: cancelled_subscriptions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Cancelled subscriptions from the subscriptions source; missing values output as 0.
      - name: total_active_subscriptions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Active subscriptions after forward-filling within (country_short, sku_id) by ascending date; if no prior non-null exists on a date, output 0.
      - name: product_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Product title from product metadata joined by (package_name, sku_id); null if no match.
      - name: country_long
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country name from country metadata by country_short using alternative name when available, else standard name; null if no match.
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Region from country metadata joined by country_short; null if no match.
      - name: sub_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sub-region from country metadata joined by country_short; null if no match.

- name: google_play__os_version_report
      description: Daily Google Play metrics by package and Android OS version with installs, events, crashes, ratings, and cumulative totals
      grain: One row per package_name, android_os_version, date_day (emitted when any source has data)

      business_logic: '- Source tables: installs, ratings, and crashes at a daily, package, and Android OS version level. - In installs, compute running cumulative totals of device installs and device uninstalls per package_name and android_os_version, ordered by date_day ascending and inclusive of the current day. - Full outer join installs, ratings, and crashes on date_day, package_name, and android_os_version: - For join equality only, treat NULL android_os_version as the placeholder ''null_os'' to align NULLs across sources. - Output keys (date_day, package_name, android_os_version) are the coalesced values across sources; if all are NULL for a key, the output remains NULL. - Rows are emitted when any source has data; duplicates in sources are not deduplicated. - Null handling: - Device/user counts, event counts, crashes, ANRs, and active devices are set to 0 when missing from their source. - average_rating and rolling_total_average_rating from ratings remain nullable. - Forward-fill within each package_name and android_os_version, ordered by date_day ascending: - Carry the most recent non-NULL value forward for rolling_total_average_rating, total_device_installs, and total_device_uninstalls. - Leading periods before the first non-NULL value remain NULL. - After forward-fill, total_device_installs and total_device_uninstalls are set to 0 where still NULL; rolling_total_average_rating remains nullable. - Final calculation: - net_device_installs equals total_device_installs minus total_device_uninstalls. - All windowed operations are ordered by date_day ascending and partitioned by package_name and android_os_version.'

      - name: total_device_installs
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Running total of device installs within each package and OS ordered by date, forward-filled across later dates without installs, then set to 0 where still NULL; includes the current date.

- name: google_play__overview_report
      description: Daily Google Play performance overview per app combining installs, events, store listing, crashes/ANRs, and ratings
      grain: One row per package_name per date_day present in any source
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_installs_overview
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_ratings_overview
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_crashes_overview
      - intermediate.int_google_play__store_performance
      business_logic: '- Aggregate store performance: - Filter intermediate.int_google_play__store_performance to performance_type = ''country''. - For each (date_day, package_name), sum visitors and installers; take the simple (unweighted) average of conversion rate, ignoring missing values. - Compute running totals for installs: - For each package_name ordered by date_day ascending, compute cumulative totals of daily_device_installs and daily_device_uninstalls. - Combine sources: - Full outer join installs (with running totals), ratings, store_performance (aggregated), and crashes on (date_day, package_name). - When date or package is missing in a source, choose the first available from installs, then ratings, then store_performance, then crashes. - Set missing counts to 0 for device/user installs, uninstalls, upgrades; install/uninstall/update events; crashes; ANRs; active devices; store installers and visitors. Leave store listing conversion rate and daily average rating as NULL if absent. - Forward-fill selected metrics by app: - Within each package_name ordered by date_day, carry forward the latest non-null values for total average rating, cumulative device installs, and cumulative device uninstalls; before the first non-null appears, these remain NULL. - Final calculations: - Default total_device_installs and total_device_uninstalls to 0 in the output. - rolling_store_conversion_rate = acquisitions divided by visitors, rounded to 4 decimals; return NULL when visitors is 0. - net_device_installs = total_device_installs minus total_device_uninstalls. - Output one row per (package_name, date_day).'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date chosen from the first available among installs, ratings, store performance, and crashes in that order
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: package_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: App package identifier chosen from the first available among installs, ratings, store performance, and crashes in that order
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: device_installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device installs; missing values set to 0; no smoothing or rounding
      - name: device_uninstalls
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device uninstalls; missing values set to 0; no smoothing or rounding
      - name: device_upgrades
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily device upgrades; missing values set to 0; no smoothing or rounding
      - name: user_installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily user installs; missing values set to 0; no smoothing or rounding
      - name: user_uninstalls
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily user uninstalls; missing values set to 0; no smoothing or rounding
      - name: crashes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily crash events; missing values set to 0; per app per day
      - name: anrs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily ANR events; missing values set to 0; per app per day
      - name: install_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily install events; missing values set to 0; event counts unchanged
      - name: uninstall_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily uninstall events; missing values set to 0; event counts unchanged
      - name: update_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily update events; missing values set to 0; event counts unchanged
      - name: store_listing_acquisitions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of store installers across country rows per day and app; defaults to 0 when store performance is absent
      - name: store_listing_visitors
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of store visitors across country rows per day and app; defaults to 0 when store performance is absent
      - name: store_listing_conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Unweighted average of store listing conversion rate across country rows per day and app; NULL when no rows; no rounding applied
      - name: active_devices_last_30_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Active devices in the last 30 days from installs; missing values set to 0
      - name: average_rating
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Daily average rating; may be NULL; three-decimal precision
      - name: rolling_total_average_rating
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: Forward-filled total average rating per app ordered by date; remains NULL until the first non-null appears
      - name: total_device_installs
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Cumulative device installs per app ordered by date; forward-filled across days without install data; defaults to 0 in output
      - name: total_device_uninstalls
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Cumulative device uninstalls per app ordered by date; forward-filled across days without install data; defaults to 0 in output
      - name: rolling_store_conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Acquisitions divided by visitors, rounded to 4 decimals; returns NULL when visitors equals 0
      - name: net_device_installs
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total device installs minus total device uninstalls after defaulting NULLs to 0

- name: stg_google_play__earnings
      description: "Cleaned and standardized earnings transaction data from Google Play Console"
      source_table: "raw.earnings"
      columns:
        - name: amount_buyer_currency
          data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "amount_buyer_currency >= -999999.99 AND amount_buyer_currency <= 999999.99"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: amount_merchant_currency
          data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        - name: base_plan_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: buyer_country
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: buyer_currency
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "buyer_currency = UPPER(TRIM(buyer_currency))"
              on_failure: correct
            - rule: "LENGTH(buyer_currency) = 3"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: buyer_postal_code
          data_type: DOUBLE
        - name: buyer_state
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: currency_conversion_rate
          data_type: DOUBLE
        - name: order_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: buyer_hardware
          data_type: DOUBLE
        - name: merchant_currency
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: offer_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: package_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
        - name: product_title
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: product_type
          data_type: BOOLEAN
        - name: refund_type
          data_type: DOUBLE
        - name: sku_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
        - name: tax_type
          data_type: DOUBLE
        - name: transaction_date
          data_type: DATE
          constraints: [not_null]
        - name: transaction_pt_timestamp
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: transaction_timezone
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: transaction_type
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "transaction_type IN ('Charge', 'Refund', 'Other')"
              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "transaction_type = COALESCE(transaction_type, 'Other')"
              on_failure: correct
        - name: _fivetran_synced
          data_type: VARCHAR

SELECT
    try_cast(CASE WHEN try_cast(amount_buyer_currency_ AS DECIMAL(18,3)) BETWEEN -999999.99 AND 999999.99 THEN try_cast(amount_buyer_currency_ AS DECIMAL(18,3)) ELSE NULL END AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS amount_buyer_currency,
    try_cast(amount_merchant_currency_ AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS amount_merchant_currency,
    CAST(base_plan_id AS VARCHAR) AS base_plan_id,
    CAST(buyer_country AS VARCHAR) AS buyer_country,
    CAST(CASE WHEN length(upper(trim(buyer_currency))) = 3 THEN upper(trim(buyer_currency)) ELSE NULL END AS VARCHAR) AS buyer_currency,
    try_cast(buyer_postal_code AS DOUBLE) AS buyer_postal_code,
    CAST(buyer_state AS VARCHAR) AS buyer_state,
    try_cast(currency_conversion_rate AS DOUBLE) AS currency_conversion_rate,
    CAST(description AS VARCHAR) AS order_id,
    try_cast(hardware AS DOUBLE) AS buyer_hardware,
    CAST(merchant_currency AS VARCHAR) AS merchant_currency,
    CAST(offer_id AS VARCHAR) AS offer_id,
    CAST(base_plan_id AS VARCHAR) AS package_name,
    CAST(product_title AS VARCHAR) AS product_title,
    try_cast(product_type AS BOOLEAN) AS product_type,
    try_cast(refund_type AS DOUBLE) AS refund_type,
    CAST(coalesce(sku_id, product_id, base_plan_id) AS VARCHAR) AS sku_id,
    try_cast(tax_type AS DOUBLE) AS tax_type,
    try_cast(substr(transaction_time, 1, 10) AS DATE) AS transaction_date,
    try_cast(substr(transaction_time, 1, 19) AS TIMESTAMP) AS transaction_pt_timestamp,
    CAST(regexp_extract(transaction_time, '([+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})', 1) AS VARCHAR) AS transaction_timezone,
    CAST(CASE WHEN lower(trim(transaction_type)) = 'charge' THEN 'Charge' WHEN lower(trim(transaction_type)) = 'refund' THEN 'Refund' WHEN lower(trim(transaction_type)) = 'other' THEN 'Other' ELSE NULL END AS VARCHAR) AS transaction_type,
    CAST(_modified AS VARCHAR) AS _fivetran_synced
FROM raw.earnings

- name: int_hubspot__owner_performance_metrics
      schema: intermediate
      description: Sales owner performance metrics with counts, revenue, cycle times, rankings, percentiles, and rule-based classifications
      grain: One row per owner_id with at least one deal
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__deals_enhanced (owner_id, amount, pipeline_stage_label, pipeline_label, deal_pipeline_stage_id, created_date, closed_date)
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__owners_enhanced (owner_id, owner_full_name, owner_email_address)
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_hubspot__deals_enhanced, keeping only deals with a non-NULL owner_id. - For each deal, derive: - deal_status: Won if closed_date is present and amount > 0; Lost if closed_date is present and amount = 0; Open if closed_date is missing; otherwise Unknown. - deal_size_category: Enterprise (100K+) if amount >= 100000; Large (50K-100K) if amount >= 50000; Medium (10K-50K) if amount >= 10000; Small (<10K) if amount > 0; else No Value. - deal_cycle_time_days: number of days between created_date and closed_date when both exist; otherwise NULL. - Left join to intermediate.int_hubspot__owners_enhanced on owner_id to bring owner_full_name and owner_email_address. - Aggregate by owner_id, owner_name, owner_email: - Counts: total_deals (all deals); won_deals (status Won); lost_deals (status Lost); open_deals (status Open). - Win rate: wins divided by (wins + losses) times 100; if there are no closed (Won/Lost) deals then 0. - Revenue: total_won_revenue = sum of amounts from Won deals (non-won contribute 0; NULL amounts are ignored); avg_won_deal_size = average amount for Won deals (NULL if none); pipeline_value = sum of amounts from Open deals (non-open contribute 0; NULL amounts are ignored). - Velocity: avg_won_cycle_time = average cycle days for Won; avg_lost_cycle_time = average cycle days for Lost (both NULL if none). - Dates: first_deal_date = earliest created_date; latest_deal_date = latest created_date; last_won_date = latest close_date among Won. - Size distribution: counts of Enterprise, Large, Medium, and Small as defined above. - Size-specific win rates: within Enterprise and Large respectively, wins divided by (wins + losses) times 100; if no closed deals in that size then 0. - Keep only owners with total_deals > 0. - Compute window metrics across all remaining owners (no partitions): - revenue_rank: position when ordering by total_won_revenue descending (1 = highest; ties break arbitrarily). - win_rate_rank: position when ordering by win_rate_percentage descending (1 = highest; ties break arbitrarily). - deals_won_rank: position when ordering by won_deals descending (1 = highest; ties break arbitrarily). - cycle_time_rank: position when ordering by average won cycle time ascending; missing averages are treated as 999 days (1 = shortest). - revenue_percentile: percentile rank scaled 0–100 by total_won_revenue (lowest = 0, highest = 100). - win_rate_percentile: percentile rank scaled 0–100 by win_rate_percentage (lowest = 0, highest = 100). - volume_percentile: percentile rank scaled 0–100 by won_deals (lowest = 0, highest = 100). - efficiency_percentile: percentile rank scaled 0–100 by average won cycle time in descending order with missing treated as 999 (0 = slowest or NULL, 100 = fastest). - overall_performance_score: take the percentile ranks (0–1) for revenue, win rate, won deals, and cycle time (faster = higher), weight them 40/25/20/15 respectively, sum them, then multiply by 100; the score ranges from 0 to 10000. - Classifications: - performance_tier: Top Performer if score >= 80; High Performer if >= 60; Core Performer if >= 40; Developing Performer if >= 20; else Needs Improvement. - sales_specialization: Enterprise Specialist if enterprise_deals > (large_deals + medium_deals + small_deals); Large Deal Specialist if large_deals > (enterprise_deals + medium_deals + small_deals); Generalist if the total across size categories >= 3; else Focused Seller. - development_focus (first match applies): if win_rate_percentage < 15 and avg_won_cycle_time > 90 then Focus on Qualification and Process; else if win_rate_percentage < 15 then Improve Win Rate; else if avg_won_cycle_time > 120 then Accelerate Sales Cycle; else if won_deals < 5 then Increase Activity Volume; else Maintain Current Performance. - pipeline_health_status (evaluated in order): Strong Pipeline if pipeline_value >= 2 × total_won_revenue; Healthy Pipeline if >= total_won_revenue; Adequate Pipeline if >= 0.5 × total_won_revenue; else Weak Pipeline.'

      - name: overall_performance_score

      - name: performance_tier

- name: hubspot__sales_performance_dashboard
      schema: sales
      description: Quarterly sales performance metrics and forecasts derived from deal-level activity
      grain: One row per created_year and created_quarter
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics
      business_logic: '- Build quarterly_sales_metrics (qsm) from intermediate.int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics (dpb): - Keep records where created_year and created_quarter are present; aggregate by created_year, created_quarter. - Distinct counts of deal_id: total created, Won, Lost, Open; null deal_id never counted. - Revenue: - revenue_won_in_quarter: sum of deal_amount for Won deals; non-Won contribute zero; null amounts do not affect the sum. - pipeline_value_in_quarter: sum of deal_amount for Open deals; others contribute zero; null amounts ignored. - Averages and distribution for Won deals only: - avg_won_deal_size: average deal_amount; null amounts ignored; returns null if no values. - avg_sales_cycle_days: average deal_cycle_time_days; null values ignored; returns null if none. - median_sales_cycle_days: continuous 50th percentile of deal_cycle_time_days; null if none. - p25_deal_size: continuous 25th percentile of deal_amount; null if none. - p75_deal_size: continuous 75th percentile of deal_amount; null if none. - quarterly_win_rate (%): 100 times distinct Won divided by distinct Won+Lost; returns 0 if no Won+Lost. - active_sales_reps_in_quarter: distinct owner_id across all deals; null owner_id excluded. - Build forecast_metrics (fm), grouped by created_year, created_quarter: - total_open_pipeline: sum of deal_amount for Open deals; null amounts ignored. - weighted_pipeline_forecast: for Open deals, sum of deal_amount multiplied by the deal_size_category’s historical win rate (average of 1 for Won, 0 otherwise across all data); use 0.15 if no category history; null amounts ignored. - time_weighted_forecast: for Open deals with unknown cycle time, sum of deal_amount multiplied by a recency factor based on created_date relative to quarter boundaries at execution time (0.3 for current quarter, 0.5 for last quarter, 0.7 if older); null amounts ignored. - Left join qsm to fm on created_year and created_quarter. - Previous-quarter benchmarks: - Sort by created_year, created_quarter ascending; prev_quarter_revenue and prev_quarter_win_rate take the prior row’s values; first applicable row returns null. - Growth and indicators: - revenue_growth_rate (%): 100 times (current revenue_won_in_quarter minus previous) divided by previous; null if previous is null or not positive. - quarterly_performance_rating: Excellent if win_rate ≥ 30 and avg cycle ≤ 60; Good if win_rate ≥ 20 and avg cycle ≤ 90; Average if win_rate ≥ 15 and avg cycle ≤ 120; otherwise Below Average. - revenue_per_sales_rep: revenue_won_in_quarter divided by active_sales_reps_in_quarter; returns 0 if rep count is 0. - revenue_per_deal_created: revenue_won_in_quarter divided by deals_created_in_quarter; returns 0 if deal count is 0. - quarterly_goal_status: Exceeded Target if revenue_won_in_quarter ≥ 1,000,000; Met Target if ≥ 750,000; Close to Target if ≥ 500,000; otherwise Below Target. - Final output is sorted by created_year and created_quarter descending; the grain is one row per year-quarter.'
      columns:
      - name: created_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar year of deal creation; grouping key; never NULL in output
      - name: created_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar quarter (1–4) of deal creation; grouping key; never NULL in output
      - name: deals_created_in_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of deal_id in the quarter; NULL deal_id excluded
      - name: deals_won_in_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of deal_id with status Won in the quarter; NULL deal_id excluded
      - name: deals_lost_in_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of deal_id with status Lost in the quarter; NULL deal_id excluded
      - name: deals_still_open
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of deal_id with status Open in the quarter; NULL deal_id excluded
      - name: revenue_won_in_quarter

        description: Sum of deal_amount for Won deals in the quarter; others contribute zero; NULL amounts ignored
      - name: pipeline_value_in_quarter
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of deal_amount for Open deals in the quarter; others contribute zero; NULL amounts ignored
      - name: total_open_pipeline

        description: Revenue_won_in_quarter from the previous quarter based on ascending year-quarter order; NULL for the first applicable row
      - name: revenue_growth_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs previous quarter revenue; NULL if previous is NULL or not positive
      - name: avg_won_deal_size
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average deal_amount for Won deals in the quarter; NULL amounts ignored; NULL if no values
      - name: p25_deal_size
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Continuous 25th percentile of deal_amount for Won deals in the quarter; NULL if no values
      - name: p75_deal_size
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Continuous 75th percentile of deal_amount for Won deals in the quarter; NULL if no values
      - name: avg_sales_cycle_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average deal_cycle_time_days for Won deals in the quarter; NULL values ignored; NULL if none
      - name: median_sales_cycle_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Continuous 50th percentile of deal_cycle_time_days for Won deals in the quarter; NULL if none
      - name: active_sales_reps_in_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of owner_id across all deals in the quarter; NULL owner_id excluded
      - name: revenue_per_sales_rep
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue_won_in_quarter divided by active_sales_reps_in_quarter; returns 0 when rep count is 0
      - name: revenue_per_deal_created
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue_won_in_quarter divided by deals_created_in_quarter; returns 0 when deal count is 0
      - name: weighted_pipeline_forecast
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum for Open deals of deal_amount × category win rate (average of 1 for Won, 0 otherwise by deal_size_category); uses 0.15 if no history; NULL amounts ignored
      - name: time_weighted_forecast
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Sum for Open deals with unknown cycle time of deal_amount × recency factor (0.3 current quarter, 0.5 last quarter, 0.7 older) using quarter boundaries at execution; NULL amounts ignored
      - name: quarterly_performance_rating
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Rating determined by win rate and average cycle time using ordered thresholds
      - name: quarterly_goal_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Target attainment from revenue_won_in_quarter: ≥1,000,000 Exceeded, ≥750,000 Met, ≥500,000 Close, otherwise Below'
