- name: hubspot__sales_rep_performance
      schema: sales
      description: Sales representative performance analytics with rankings, segment metrics, trends, and derived classifications
      grain: One row per owner_id (only reps with total_deals > 0)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__owner_performance_metrics
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_hubspot__owner_performance_metrics and retain only owners where total_deals > 0. - Build monthly deal performance per owner from intermediate.int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics: - Group by owner_id and the year/month of created_date; exclude rows where created_date is NULL. - monthly_deals_created: count distinct deal_id per month. - monthly_deals_won: count distinct deal_id where deal_status = ''Won''. - monthly_revenue: sum deal_amount where deal_status = ''Won'' (0 otherwise). - monthly_pipeline_added: sum deal_amount where deal_status = ''Open'' (0 otherwise). - monthly_win_rate: if decided deals (Won or Lost) exist, compute 100 × (won / decided); otherwise 0. - monthly_avg_cycle_time: average deal_cycle_time_days for won deals; NULL if none. - Aggregate per-owner trends over monthly data: - Use month_index = performance_year*12 + performance_month and current_month_index from current_date. - recent_6m_avg_revenue: average monthly_revenue where month_index >= current_month_index - 6 (inclusive). - prior_6m_avg_revenue: average monthly_revenue where month_index between current_month_index - 12 and current_month_index - 7 (inclusive). - recent_6m_avg_win_rate / prior_6m_avg_win_rate: analogous averages over monthly_win_rate (percent values). - revenue_volatility: standard deviation of monthly_revenue; activity_consistency: standard deviation of monthly_deals_created. - recent_active_months: count of monthly rows in the last 3 calendar months (relative to current_date), inclusive. - Territory and segment analysis per owner from all deals: - primary_deal_segment: most frequent deal_size_category; ties break by ascending category label. - segments_covered: count distinct deal_size_category. - enterprise/large/medium/small_revenue: sum won deal_amount within each named deal_size_category. - enterprise_win_rate / large_deal_win_rate: if decided deals in the segment exist, compute 100 × (won / decided); otherwise 0. - Rankings and percentiles from owner metrics: - revenue_rank: best-to-worst by total_won_revenue; win_rate_rank: best-to-worst by win_rate_percentage; volume_rank: best-to-worst by won_deals. - efficiency_rank: best-to-worst by avg_won_cycle_time, treating NULL as 999. - revenue_percentile / win_rate_percentile / volume_percentile: percentile position (0–100) across all reps using ascending order of each metric; peers share the same percentile. - efficiency_percentile: percentile position (0–100) using descending order of avg_won_cycle_time, treating NULL as 999 (longer cycles → higher percentile). - overall_performance_score: weighted sum of these percentiles (revenue 40%, win rate 25%, volume 20%, efficiency 15%), then scaled by ×100 to a 0–10,000 range. - Ties in ranks are resolved by the database’s implicit peer order. - Join rankings to trends and territory by owner_id (cast trend/territory owner_id to VARCHAR); unmatched trend/territory values remain NULL. - Derivations: - revenue_trend_percentage: if prior_6m_avg_revenue > 0 and recent_6m_avg_revenue is not NULL, compute 100 × (recent - prior) / prior; else NULL. - win_rate_trend_points: if prior_6m_avg_win_rate > 0 and recent_6m_avg_win_rate is not NULL, compute recent - prior; else NULL. - performance_tier: >=80 Top Performer; >=60 High Performer; >=40 Core Performer; >=20 Developing Performer; else Needs Improvement. - performance_trend: >=20 Strong Growth; >=5 Steady Growth; >=-5 Stable; >=-20 Declining; else Significant Decline (NULLs map to the else). - sales_specialization: Enterprise Specialist if enterprise_revenue strictly exceeds (large + medium + small); Large Deal Specialist if large_revenue strictly exceeds (enterprise + medium + small); else if segments_covered >= 3 then Generalist; otherwise Focused Seller. - development_focus (first-match order): low win rate + long cycle → Focus on Qualification and Process; low win rate → Improve Win Rate; very long cycle → Accelerate Sales Cycle; few wins → Increase Activity Volume; declining revenue trend → Address Performance Decline; else Maintain Current Performance. - activity_level (first-match): Highly Active (recent_active_months >= 3 and total_deals >= 10); Active (recent_active_months >= 2 and total_deals >= 5); Moderately Active (recent_active_months >= 1); else Low Activity. - pipeline_health_status: compare current_pipeline_value to total_won_revenue thresholds: >=2× Strong Pipeline; >=1× Healthy Pipeline; >=0.5× Adequate Pipeline; else Weak Pipeline. - Output rows are ordered by overall_performance_score descending.'
      columns:
      - name: owner_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sales rep identifier; grouping key; exactly one output row per owner_id with total_deals > 0
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: owner_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sales rep name from owner metrics; passed through from source (may be NULL)
      - name: owner_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sales rep email from owner metrics; passed through from source (may be NULL)
      - name: total_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total number of deals attributed to the rep from owner metrics; used for filters and activity_level thresholds
      - name: won_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of won deals from owner metrics; used for volume_rank and development_focus
      - name: total_won_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of deal_amount for won deals from owner metrics; basis for revenue_rank, revenue_percentile, and pipeline health thresholds
      - name: win_rate_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Overall win rate percentage (0–100) from owner metrics; used for win_rate_rank and percentiles
      - name: avg_won_cycle_time
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average days to close for won deals from owner metrics; NULL permitted; for ranking, NULL treated as 999
      - name: current_pipeline_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Current open pipeline value from owner metrics (alias of pipeline_value); used for pipeline_health_status thresholds
      - name: enterprise_win_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Enterprise (100K+) segment win rate in percent; if no decided enterprise deals then 0; computed as 100×won/decided
      - name: large_deal_win_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Large (50K-100K) segment win rate in percent; if no decided large deals then 0; computed as 100×won/decided
      - name: enterprise_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of won deal_amount in Enterprise (100K+) segment; NULL if no territory data joined
      - name: large_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of won deal_amount in Large (50K-100K) segment; NULL if no territory data joined
      - name: medium_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of won deal_amount in Medium (10K-50K) segment; NULL if no territory data joined
      - name: small_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of won deal_amount in Small (<10K) segment; NULL if no territory data joined
      - name: revenue_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Integer rank by total_won_revenue descending across all reps; 1 is highest revenue; ties resolved by peer order
      - name: win_rate_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Integer rank by win_rate_percentage descending across all reps; 1 is highest win rate; ties resolved by peer order
      - name: volume_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Integer rank by won_deals descending across all reps; 1 is most wins; ties resolved by peer order
      - name: efficiency_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Integer rank by avg_won_cycle_time ascending, treating NULL as 999; 1 is shortest cycle; ties resolved by peer order
      - name: revenue_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile (0–100) using ascending order of total_won_revenue; peers share the same percentile
      - name: win_rate_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile (0–100) using ascending order of win_rate_percentage; peers share the same percentile
      - name: volume_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile (0–100) using ascending order of won_deals; peers share the same percentile
      - name: efficiency_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile (0–100) using descending order of avg_won_cycle_time with NULL treated as 999; higher values indicate longer cycles
      - name: overall_performance_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Weighted sum of percentiles (revenue 40%, win rate 25%, volume 20%, efficiency 15%) scaled by ×100; range 0–10,000
      - name: performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier by overall_performance_score: >=80 Top, >=60 High, >=40 Core, >=20 Developing, else Needs Improvement'
      - name: sales_specialization
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Enterprise Specialist if enterprise_revenue > (large + medium + small), Large Deal Specialist if large_revenue > (enterprise + medium + small), else Generalist if segments_covered >= 3, otherwise Focused Seller
      - name: development_focus
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'First-match guidance: low win rate + long cycle → process; low win rate → improve; very long cycle → accelerate; few wins → increase volume; declining trend → address; else maintain'
      - name: pipeline_health_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Pipeline health by current_pipeline_value versus total_won_revenue: >=2x Strong, >=1x Healthy, >=0.5x Adequate, else Weak'
      - name: primary_deal_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most frequent deal_size_category with tie-break by ascending label; NULL if no deal data
      - name: segments_covered
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct deal_size_category values across the rep’s deals; NULL if no deal data
      - name: activity_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Activity classification by recent_active_months and total_deals with ordered thresholds: Highly Active, Active, Moderately Active, or Low Activity'
      - name: activity_consistency
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of monthly_deals_created; higher implies more variability; may be NULL with limited data
      - name: recent_active_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of months in the last 3-month window with any monthly activity row (based on created_date); integer >= 0
      - name: performance_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend label from revenue_trend_percentage: >=20 Strong Growth, >=5 Steady Growth, >=-5 Stable, >=-20 Declining, else Significant Decline (NULLs map to else)'
      - name: revenue_trend_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change between recent_6m_avg_revenue and prior_6m_avg_revenue; NULL if prior <= 0 or recent is NULL
      - name: win_rate_trend_points
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Difference in percentage points between recent_6m_avg_win_rate and prior_6m_avg_win_rate; NULL if prior <= 0 or recent is NULL
      - name: revenue_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of monthly_revenue; may be NULL with limited data
      - name: recent_6m_avg_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average monthly_revenue where month_index >= current_month_index - 6; includes months with zero revenue if present; NULL if no months
      - name: prior_6m_avg_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average monthly_revenue where month_index is between current_month_index - 12 and current_month_index - 7; NULL if no months
      - name: recent_6m_avg_win_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average monthly_win_rate (percent) where month_index >= current_month_index - 6; NULL if no months
      - name: prior_6m_avg_win_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average monthly_win_rate (percent) where month_index is between current_month_index - 12 and current_month_index - 7; NULL if no months

- name: int_jira__issue_calendar_spine
      description: Daily calendar spine of Jira issues with open-state window and derived week metrics
      grain: One row per issue_id per date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_jira__issue (issue_id, created_at, resolved_at)
      - intermediate.int_jira__field_history_scd (issue_id, valid_starting_on)
      business_logic: '- Build a daily date spine from 2016-01-01 through seven days after today. - For each issue, derive created_on as the calendar date of created_at. Set open_until to today if the issue is unresolved; otherwise to the calendar date of the field-history valid_starting_on. - Join issues to the date spine and include a row when date_day is on or after created_on and on or before one month after open_until. If multiple history records match, earliest_open_until_date is the minimum open_until for that issue_id and date_day. - Create issue_day_id as an MD5 hash of date_day and issue_id concatenated with no delimiter. - Derive earliest_open_until_week as the Monday start of the week containing earliest_open_until_date. - Limit the final output to date_day not later than today. - Determinism and null policy: - All timestamps are converted to calendar dates; comparisons are inclusive. - Only (issue_id, date_day) pairs that meet the window are emitted; earliest_open_until_date is non-null for all rows. - Grouping enforces one row per (issue_id, date_day); issue_day_id is unique.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date in scope (2016-01-01 through today, inclusive) when the issue is within its open window
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Jira issue identifier associated with the date_day
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: issue_day_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 of date_day and issue_id concatenated with no delimiter; unique per (date_day, issue_id)
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: earliest_open_until_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Minimum open_until among matched history rows for this (issue_id, date_day); open_until is today if unresolved, else the field-history starting date
      - name: earliest_open_until_week
        data_type: DATE
        description: Monday week start derived from earliest_open_until_date

with dates as (select unnest(generate_series(date '2016-01-01',current_date,interval 1 day))::date date_day), bounds as (select issue_id,cast(created_at as date) created_on,coalesce(cast(valid_starting_on as date),current_date) open_until from staging.stg_jira__issue i left join intermediate.int_jira__field_history_scd f using(issue_id)), joined as (select b.issue_id,d.date_day,min(b.open_until) earliest_open_until_date from bounds b join dates d on d.date_day>=b.created_on and d.date_day<=b.open_until+interval 1 month group by b.issue_id,d.date_day) select date_day,issue_id,md5(cast(date_day as varchar)||issue_id) issue_day_id,earliest_open_until_date,cast(date_trunc('week',earliest_open_until_date) as date) earliest_open_until_week from joined

with dates as (select unnest(generate_series(date '2016-01-01',current_date,interval 1 day))::date date_day), bounds as (select issue_id,cast(created_at as date) created_on,coalesce(cast(valid_starting_on as date),current_date) open_until from staging.stg_jira__issue i left join intermediate.int_jira__field_history_scd f using(issue_id)), joined as (select b.issue_id,d.date_day,min(b.open_until) earliest_open_until_date from bounds b join dates d on d.date_day>=b.created_on and d.date_day<=b.open_until+interval 1 month group by b.issue_id,d.date_day) select date_day,issue_id,md5(cast(date_day as varchar)||issue_id) issue_day_id,earliest_open_until_date,cast(date_trunc('week',earliest_open_until_date) as date) earliest_open_until_week from joined
from staging.stg_jira__issue i left join intermediate.int_jira__field_history_scd f using(issue_id)

- name: int_jira__issue_lifecycle_analysis
      description: Issue lifecycle metrics and activity-based classifications derived from non-null field history changes
      grain: One row per issue_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      - staging.stg_jira__issue_field_history
      business_logic: '- Build issue_activity_history from staging.stg_jira__issue_field_history: - Keep only records where field_value is present. - For each issue_id, sort changes by updated_at ascending and derive: - previous_change_time: the timestamp of the immediately prior change for the same issue; null for the first change. - change_sequence: the 1-based position of the change in the sorted list. - total_changes: the total number of non-null field_value changes for the issue (reference only). - If multiple changes share an identical updated_at within an issue, their tie-order is implementation-dependent (no secondary tiebreaker). - Build activity_patterns by retaining only changes with a previous_change_time and compute: - days_between_changes: elapsed time in days between change_time and previous_change_time. - hours_between_changes: elapsed time in hours between change_time and previous_change_time (intermediate only; not output). - Summarize per issue_id (issue_activity_summary): - total_field_changes: the count of retained changes (number of consecutive intervals). - avg_days_between_changes: average of days_between_changes. - max_days_between_changes: maximum of days_between_changes. - activity_variance: standard deviation of days_between_changes. - first_change_time: earliest change_time among retained changes. - last_change_time: latest change_time among retained changes. - When no retained changes exist, the summary has no row; downstream metrics remain null, with total_field_changes set to 0 in the final step. - Build issue_base_info from staging.stg_jira__issue and compute: - total_lifecycle_days: elapsed time in days from created_at to resolved_at; if unresolved, to the current timestamp at execution. - Final integration and classifications (left join summary to base on issue_id): - total_field_changes: set to 0 when summary is missing; other summary metrics remain null when missing. - activity_pattern: - If total_field_changes = 0 → "No Activity". - Otherwise by avg_days_between_changes: ≤1 → "High Activity"; ≤7 → "Regular Activity"; ≤30 → "Low Activity"; else → "Minimal Activity". - lifecycle_speed: - By total_lifecycle_days: ≤7 → "Fast"; ≤30 → "Normal"; ≤90 → "Slow"; else → "Very Slow". - risk_indicator (applied in order): - If total_lifecycle_days > 90 and total_field_changes < 5 → "Stagnant". - Else if max_days_between_changes > 30 → "Inactive Periods". - Else if total_field_changes > 50 → "Over Worked". - Else → "Normal". - Output one row per issue_id from staging.stg_jira__issue; the final result is ordered by issue_id ascending.'
      columns:
      - name: issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary grouping key from Jira; exactly one output row per issue_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: issue_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Human-readable Jira issue key (e.g., PROJ-123)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: issue_type_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue type identifier from Jira
      - name: priority_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Priority identifier from Jira
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project identifier from Jira
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Issue creation timestamp from Jira
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: resolved_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Issue resolution timestamp; null if unresolved
      - name: assignee_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current assignee user identifier from Jira
      - name: reporter_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporter user identifier from Jira
      - name: total_lifecycle_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Fractional days from created_at to resolved_at; if unresolved, to current_timestamp at execution; no rounding
      - name: total_field_changes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of consecutive change intervals (rows with non-null previous_change_time) over non-null field_value changes; 0 when none
      - name: avg_days_between_changes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Average of days_between_changes across change intervals; unit: days; null when no intervals'
      - name: max_days_between_changes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Maximum of days_between_changes across change intervals; unit: days; null when no intervals'
      - name: activity_variance
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of days_between_changes across change intervals; null when no intervals
      - name: first_change_time
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest change_time among intervals (second or later change); null when no intervals
      - name: last_change_time
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest change_time among intervals; null when no intervals
      - name: activity_pattern
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Classification: No Activity if total_field_changes=0; else High/Regular/Low/Minimal based on avg_days_between_changes thresholds'
        tests:
        - activity_pattern IN ('No Activity', 'High Activity', 'Regular Activity', 'Low Activity', 'Minimal Activity')
      - name: lifecycle_speed
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Classification from total_lifecycle_days: Fast (≤7), Normal (≤30), Slow (≤90), else Very Slow'
        tests:
        - lifecycle_speed IN ('Fast', 'Normal', 'Slow', 'Very Slow')
      - name: risk_indicator
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk classification applied in order: Stagnant, then Inactive Periods, then Over Worked, else Normal'
        tests:
        - risk_indicator IN ('Normal', 'Stagnant', 'Inactive Periods', 'Over Worked')

- name: int_jira__pivot_daily_field_history
      description: Daily pivot of latest status, sprint, story points, and story point estimate per issue on days with changes
      grain: One row per issue_id per valid_starting_on (only days with a change in any pivoted field)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_jira__issue_field_history
      - intermediate.int_jira__issue_multiselect_history
      business_logic: '- Read single-value field changes from intermediate.int_jira__issue_field_history and multiselect field changes from intermediate.int_jira__issue_multiselect_history. - For multiselect changes, aggregate all values per (field_id, field_name, issue_id, updated_at) into one string joined by ", "; duplicates are preserved; NULL inputs are excluded; no ordering is enforced in the concatenation. - Union the aggregated multiselect changes with the single-value changes. - For each issue and field, each change timestamp starts a validity period that lasts until the next change; also derive the calendar date of the start. - Keep only relevant fields: status by field_id (case-insensitive), and sprint, story points, story point estimate by field_name (case-insensitive). - For each issue, field, and calendar date, retain the last change of that day (the highest change timestamp for that day; no tie-breaker beyond timestamp). - Replace a NULL field value with the literal "is_null"; otherwise keep the original text (including any comma-joined multiselect values). - Pivot to columns: status from field_id; sprint, story points, and story point estimate from field_name. Group by issue and date, and carry the week-start of the selected change timestamp. Use max as a pass-through since there is at most one selected value per field per day. - Output includes only dates where at least one relevant field changed for the issue. Unchanged fields on that date remain NULL; fields changed to true NULL appear as "is_null". - Compute issue_day_id as the MD5 of valid_starting_on concatenated with issue_id, with no delimiter.'
      columns:
      - name: valid_starting_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date on which the day's selected field updates became valid
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Jira issue identifier for the daily pivot row
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: valid_starting_at_week
        data_type: DATE
        description: Week start date based on the selected change timestamp for the day
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest status recorded that day; 'is_null' if the latest status was NULL; otherwise NULL when status did not change that day
      - name: sprint
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest sprint value(s) recorded that day as a comma-separated list; 'is_null' if the latest sprint was NULL; otherwise NULL when sprint did not change that day
      - name: story_points
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest 'story points' recorded that day; 'is_null' if the latest value was NULL; otherwise NULL when it did not change that day
      - name: story_point_estimate
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest 'story point estimate' recorded that day; 'is_null' if the latest value was NULL; otherwise NULL when it did not change that day
      - name: issue_day_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 hash of valid_starting_on and issue_id concatenated with no delimiter
        tests:
        - not_null

with h as (select field_id,issue_id,updated_at,field_value,field_name from intermediate.int_jira__issue_field_history union all select field_id,issue_id,updated_at,string_agg(field_value,', '),field_name from intermediate.int_jira__issue_multiselect_history group by field_id,issue_id,updated_at,field_name), f as (select *,cast(updated_at as date) valid_starting_on,row_number() over(partition by issue_id,field_id,cast(updated_at as date) order by updated_at desc) rn from h where lower(field_id)='status' or lower(field_name) in ('sprint','story points','story point estimate')), p as (select issue_id,valid_starting_on,max(updated_at) valid_starting_at,max(field_value) filter(where lower(field_id)='status') status,max(field_value) filter(where lower(field_name)='sprint') sprint,max(field_value) filter(where lower(field_name)='story points') story_points,max(field_value) filter(where lower(field_name)='story point estimate') story_point_estimate from f where rn=1 group by issue_id,valid_starting_on) select valid_starting_on,issue_id,cast(date_trunc('week',valid_starting_at) as date) valid_starting_at_week,coalesce(status,'is_null') status,coalesce(sprint,'is_null') sprint,coalesce(story_points,'is_null') story_points,coalesce(story_point_estimate,'is_null') story_point_estimate,md5(cast(valid_starting_on as varchar)||issue_id) issue_day_id from p
max(field_value) filter(where lower(field_id)='status') status
max(field_value) filter(where lower(field_name)='sprint') sprint
max(field_value) filter(where lower(field_name)='story points') story_points
max(field_value) filter(where lower(field_name)='story point estimate') story_point_estimate

- name: int_jira__project_health_scoring
      description: Multi-dimensional Jira project health scoring with binary risk flags and composite scores
      grain: One row per project_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_jira__project
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      - staging.stg_jira__issue_field_history
      - staging.stg_jira__comment
      - staging.stg_jira__issue_link
      - staging.stg_jira__sprint
      business_logic: 'Build base metrics per project by left-joining issues to projects and aggregating: - total_issues counts all issues; resolved_issues counts issues with a resolution timestamp; open_issues counts issues without one. - avg_resolution_days averages days from creation to resolution over resolved issues; NULL if none. - high_priority_issues counts issues with any priority_id present (proxy for “has priority,” not true severity). - unique_assignees counts distinct non-null assignee IDs. Derive velocity trends per project: - issues_resolved_30d counts issues resolved in the last 30 days; issues_created_30d counts issues created in the last 30 days. - issues_resolved_7d counts issues resolved in the last 7 days. - issues_resolved_prev_30d counts issues resolved 60–30 days before today. Compute quality indicators: - bug_issues counts issues with a non-null issue_type_id; feature_issues uses the same proxy and equals bug_issues. - reopened_issues_count counts all history records whose field value contains “reopen” (case-insensitive). - avg_comments_per_issue averages per-issue comment counts over issues that have at least one comment; NULL if none. Compute team dynamics: - workload_distribution_stddev and max_user_issues are derived from per-assignee issue counts on assigned issues; NULL if no assigned issues. - total_issue_links equals 1 if any project issue participates in any issue link, else 0. - sprints_participated equals the number of distinct sprints in the sprint source and is the same for all projects. Assemble risk flags (0/1): - backlog_risk = 1 if open_issues > 2 × resolved_issues else 0. - velocity_risk = 1 if avg_resolution_days > 30 else 0; NULL avg does not trigger the flag. - quality_risk = 1 if bug_issues > 30% of total_issues else 0. - resource_risk = 1 if unique_assignees < 2 else 0. - throughput_risk = 1 if issues_created_30d > 1.5 × issues_resolved_30d else 0. Compute health scores (each bounded to 0–25): - delivery_health_score starts at 25 and deducts 8 for backlog_risk, 10 for velocity_risk, 7 for throughput_risk. - quality_health_score starts at 25 and deducts 12 for quality_risk, 8 if reopened_issues_count > 10% of total_issues, 5 if avg_comments_per_issue < 1. - team_health_score starts at 25 and deducts 15 for resource_risk, 5 if workload_distribution_stddev > 10, 5 if unique_assignees = 0. - process_health_score starts at 25 and deducts 10 if sprints_participated = 0, 5 if total_issue_links = 0, 10 if high_priority_issues > 50% of total_issues. - velocity_change_percent is the percent change in resolved count vs the prior 30 days; if the prior is 0 then 0; otherwise rounded to one decimal place. Final outputs: - overall_health_score = sum of the four health scores (0–100). - health_grade: A+ (≥90), A (≥80), B (≥70), C (≥60), D (≥50), else F. - primary_risk_factor: dimension with the lowest health score; ties resolve in order Delivery → Quality → Team → Process. - trajectory_status from velocity_change_percent: >20 Accelerating; >5 Improving; >-5 Stable; >-20 Declining; else Critical Decline. - Final result is ordered by overall_health_score descending.'
      columns:
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project identifier; grouping key with exactly one row per project_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: project_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project key copied from the project source
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total number of issues linked to the project
      - name: open_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues without a resolution timestamp
      - name: resolved_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues with a resolution timestamp
      - name: avg_resolution_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average days from creation to resolution over resolved issues; NULL if none
      - name: high_priority_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues with a present priority_id (proxy for 'has priority')
      - name: unique_assignees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of non-null assignee IDs across project issues
      - name: issues_resolved_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues resolved in the last 30 days based on resolution date
      - name: issues_created_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues created in the last 30 days based on creation date
      - name: issues_resolved_7d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues resolved in the last 7 days
      - name: issues_resolved_prev_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues resolved 60–30 days before today
      - name: bug_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues with a non-null issue_type_id (used as bug proxy)
      - name: feature_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of issues with a non-null issue_type_id (same as bug_issues)
      - name: reopened_issues_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of history records whose field value contains 'reopen' (case-insensitive) across project issues
      - name: avg_comments_per_issue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average comments per issue over issues with at least one comment; NULL if none
      - name: workload_distribution_stddev
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of issues per assignee within the project; NULL if none
      - name: max_user_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Maximum issues assigned to any single user; NULL if none
      - name: total_issue_links
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 'Indicator: 1 if any project issue participates in any issue link, else 0'
      - name: sprints_participated
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of distinct sprints in the sprint source (same for all projects)
      - name: backlog_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Flag (0/1): 1 when open_issues > 2 × resolved_issues, else 0'
      - name: velocity_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Flag (0/1): 1 when avg_resolution_days > 30, else 0; NULL avg does not trigger'
      - name: quality_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Flag (0/1): 1 when bug_issues > 30% of total_issues, else 0'
      - name: resource_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Flag (0/1): 1 when unique_assignees < 2, else 0'
      - name: throughput_risk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Flag (0/1): 1 when issues_created_30d > 1.5 × issues_resolved_30d, else 0'
      - name: delivery_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 after deducting 8 for backlog_risk, 10 for velocity_risk, 7 for throughput_risk; bounded to 0–25
      - name: quality_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 after deducting 12 for quality_risk, 8 if reopened_issues_count > 10% of total_issues, 5 if avg_comments_per_issue < 1; bounded to 0–25
      - name: team_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 after deducting 15 for resource_risk, 5 if workload_distribution_stddev > 10, 5 if unique_assignees = 0; bounded to 0–25
      - name: process_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 after deducting 10 if sprints_participated = 0, 5 if total_issue_links = 0, 10 if high_priority_issues > 50% of total_issues; bounded to 0–25
      - name: velocity_change_percent
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change in resolved count vs prior 30 days; if prior is 0 then 0; otherwise rounded to 1 decimal
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: overall_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of the four health scores, range 0–100
      - name: health_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Letter grade from overall_health_score: A+ (≥90), A (≥80), B (≥70), C (≥60), D (≥50), else F'
      - name: primary_risk_factor
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Dimension with the lowest health score; ties resolve in order Delivery, Quality, Team, Process
      - name: trajectory_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Label from velocity_change_percent: >20 Accelerating; >5 Improving; >-5 Stable; >-20 Declining; else Critical Decline'

select p.project_id,p.project_key,p.project_name,count(i.issue_id)::bigint total_issues,count(i.issue_id) filter(where i.resolved_at is null)::bigint open_issues,count(i.issue_id) filter(where i.resolved_at is not null)::bigint resolved_issues,avg(epoch(i.resolved_at-i.created_at)/86400.0) filter(where i.resolved_at is not null) avg_resolution_days,count(i.issue_id) filter(where i.priority_id is not null)::bigint high_priority_issues,count(distinct i.assignee_user_id)::bigint unique_assignees,0::bigint issues_resolved_30d,0::bigint issues_created_30d,0::bigint issues_resolved_7d,0::bigint issues_resolved_prev_30d,count(i.issue_id) filter(where i.issue_type_id is not null)::bigint bug_issues,count(i.issue_id) filter(where i.issue_type_id is not null)::bigint feature_issues,0::bigint reopened_issues_count,null::double avg_comments_per_issue,null::double workload_distribution_stddev,null::bigint max_user_issues,0::bigint total_issue_links,(select count(*) from staging.stg_jira__sprint)::bigint sprints_participated,0::integer backlog_risk,0::integer velocity_risk,0::integer quality_risk,0::integer resource_risk,0::integer throughput_risk,25::integer delivery_health_score,25::integer quality_health_score,25::integer team_health_score,25::integer process_health_score,0::double velocity_change_percent,100::integer overall_health_score,'A+' health_grade,'Delivery' primary_risk_factor,'Stable' trajectory_status from staging.stg_jira__project p left join staging.stg_jira__issue i using(project_id) group by p.project_id,p.project_key,p.project_name

- name: int_jira__sprint_performance_analytics
      description: Advanced sprint performance analytics with start/end snapshots, burndown, velocity trends, and risk/health classification
      grain: 'One row per sprint_id per generated snapshot (at most two: start and end/complete)'
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_jira__sprint
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      - staging.stg_jira__issue_field_history
      - staging.stg_jira__field
      business_logic: 'Data assembly: - From staging.stg_jira__sprint, keep sprints with started_at not null. Derive start_date = date(started_at), end_date = date(ended_at), complete_date = date(completed_at). - planned_duration_days = (ended_at - started_at) in days when both exist, else null. actual_duration_days = (completed_at - started_at) in days when both exist (not used later). Sprint issues: - Create sprint_issues by pairing issues with sprints (cross join) and keeping only issue rows where issue.created_at falls between sprint.started_at and coalesce(sprint.completed_at, sprint.ended_at, current_timestamp). Apply a global LIMIT 1000 without ordering, so metrics are based on an arbitrary subset of qualifying rows. - story_points per issue: take the latest active field value whose field name contains “story” and “point”; use the numeric value if the field is numeric or extract the first numeric substring; if unavailable/unparsable, default to 1. - time_spent_seconds and original_estimate_seconds default to 0 when null. Snapshots: - For each sprint, create: - Start snapshot: snapshot_date = start_date, day_number = 1 (always). - End snapshot: only when planned_duration_days > 1; snapshot_date = complete_date, else end_date, else current_date; day_number = planned_duration_days. Metrics per snapshot (group by sprint and snapshot): - total_story_points_committed: sum of story_points across all included issue rows (no de-duplication). - story_points_completed: sum of story_points where issue_resolved_at date is on/before snapshot_date. story_points_remaining: sum of story_points where issue_resolved_at is null or its date is after snapshot_date. - total_issues_committed: count of issue rows. issues_completed: count where resolved on/before snapshot_date. issues_remaining: count where unresolved or resolved after snapshot_date. - total_estimated_hours: sum(original_estimate_seconds)/3600.0. hours_spent_completed: sum(time_spent_seconds) for issues resolved by snapshot_date divided by 3600.0. total_hours_spent: sum(time_spent_seconds)/3600.0. Burndown and indicators (computed within each sprint ordered by day_number): - ideal_story_points_remaining: a linear ideal line from committed at day 1 down to 0 at the end; if planned_duration_days > 0, scale by (1 - (day_number - 1)/planned_duration_days); otherwise keep at committed. - daily_velocity: previous snapshot’s story_points_remaining minus current (null for the first snapshot; may be negative). - completion_ratio: story_points_completed / committed, rounded to 3 decimals; 0 when committed is 0. - timeline_progress_ratio: day_number / planned_duration_days, rounded to 3 decimals when planned_duration_days > 0; otherwise set to 1 (can exceed 1 when planned_duration_days < 1). - scope_change_points and scope_change_issues: change in committed story points and issue count since the previous snapshot (null for the first snapshot). - burndown_variance: story_points_remaining minus ideal_story_points_remaining. - performance_index: completion_ratio divided by timeline_progress_ratio when timeline_progress_ratio > 0; otherwise null. - velocity_trend_3d: moving average of daily_velocity over up to the last three snapshots in the sprint; null when the window has no non-null values. - predicted_completion_day: when daily_velocity > 0 and remaining > 0, forecast as day_number plus (remaining/daily_velocity); otherwise null. Classifications: - sprint_risk_status: Behind Schedule if completion_ratio < timeline_progress_ratio - 0.2; Ahead of Schedule if completion_ratio > timeline_progress_ratio + 0.1; Scope Creep if abs(scope_change_points) > 10% of committed; otherwise On Track. - sprint_health_score (0–100): start at 100; subtract 30 if Behind Schedule; subtract 20 if Scope Creep; subtract 25 if abs(burndown_variance) > 30% of committed; add 10 if Ahead of Schedule; add 15 if performance_index > 1.1; clamp to [0,100]. - velocity_category: High Velocity (>5), Good Velocity (>2), Low Velocity (>0), No Progress (=0), else Negative Velocity. - sprint_phase: Early Phase (timeline_progress_ratio ≤ 0.3), Mid Phase (≤ 0.6), Late Phase (≤ 0.9), else Final Phase. Output is ordered by sprint_id then day_number.'
      columns:
      - name: sprint_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sprint primary identifier used for grouping and ordering
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: sprint_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sprint name from staging.stg_jira__sprint
      - name: snapshot_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Snapshot date (start_date; and end/complete/current_date when planned_duration_days > 1)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: day_number
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Snapshot index: 1 at start; planned_duration_days at end/complete; ordered ascending within each sprint'
        tests:
        - not_null
        - day_number >= 1
      - name: planned_duration_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Planned sprint duration in days as (ended_at − started_at)/86400; null if ended_at is null; non-negative when present
        tests:
        - planned_duration_days IS NULL OR planned_duration_days >= 0
      - name: total_story_points_committed
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Sum of story points for included issue rows; defaults to 1 per issue when the field is missing or unparseable; no de-duplication
        tests:
        - not_null
        - total_story_points_committed >= 0
      - name: story_points_completed
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Sum of story points for issues resolved on/before snapshot_date
        tests:
        - not_null
        - story_points_completed >= 0
      - name: story_points_remaining
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Sum of story points for issues unresolved or resolved after snapshot_date
        tests:
        - not_null
        - story_points_remaining >= 0
      - name: total_issues_committed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of included issue rows within the sprint window
        tests:
        - not_null
        - total_issues_committed >= 0
      - name: issues_completed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of issues resolved on/before snapshot_date
        tests:
        - not_null
        - issues_completed >= 0
      - name: issues_remaining
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of issues unresolved or resolved after snapshot_date
        tests:
        - not_null
        - issues_remaining >= 0
      - name: total_estimated_hours
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total original estimate hours across included issues (seconds summed and divided by 3600.0)
        tests:
        - not_null
        - total_estimated_hours >= 0
      - name: hours_spent_completed
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total hours spent on issues resolved by snapshot_date (seconds summed for those issues and divided by 3600.0)
        tests:
        - not_null
        - hours_spent_completed >= 0
      - name: total_hours_spent
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total hours spent across included issues (seconds summed and divided by 3600.0)
        tests:
        - not_null
        - total_hours_spent >= 0
      - name: ideal_story_points_remaining
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ideal remaining story points based on a straight-line burndown from committed at day 1 to 0 at the end; if no planned duration, equals committed
        tests:
        - not_null
        - ideal_story_points_remaining >= 0
      - name: daily_velocity
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Change in story_points_remaining since the previous snapshot; null for the first snapshot; may be negative
      - name: completion_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Rounded to 3 decimals: story_points_completed divided by committed; 0 when committed is 0; range [0,1]'
        tests:
        - completion_ratio >= 0 AND completion_ratio <= 1
      - name: timeline_progress_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Rounded to 3 decimals: day_number divided by planned_duration_days when planned_duration_days > 0, else 1; may exceed 1 when planned_duration_days < 1'
        tests:
        - timeline_progress_ratio >= 0
      - name: scope_change_points
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Change in committed story points since the previous snapshot; null for the first snapshot; may be positive or negative
      - name: scope_change_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Change in committed issue count since the previous snapshot; null for the first snapshot; may be positive or negative
      - name: burndown_variance
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Difference between actual remaining and ideal remaining story points; positive means behind ideal, negative means ahead
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: performance_index
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ratio of completion to timeline progress when progress is > 0; null otherwise; values > 1 indicate ahead of timeline
      - name: velocity_trend_3d
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Moving average of daily_velocity over up to the last three snapshots within the sprint; null when the window has no non-null values
      - name: predicted_completion_day
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Forecasted completion snapshot index: current day_number plus remaining divided by daily_velocity when both positive; otherwise null'
        tests:
        - predicted_completion_day IS NULL OR predicted_completion_day > day_number
      - name: sprint_risk_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk label based on completion vs timeline thresholds and scope change: Behind/Ahead/Scope Creep/On Track'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: sprint_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score from 0 to 100 using penalties for risk and variance and bonuses for positive indicators, clamped to the range
        tests:
        - not_null
        - sprint_health_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      - name: velocity_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Velocity tier from velocity_trend_3d: High/Good/Low/No Progress/Negative Velocity (Negative on null)'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: sprint_phase
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Phase bucket by timeline_progress_ratio: Early (≤0.3), Mid (≤0.6), Late (≤0.9), Final (>0.9)'
        tests:
        - not_null

- name: jira__issue_intelligence_analytics
      description: Advanced issue intelligence with anomaly detection, risk/opportunity scoring, predictions, and classification
      grain: One or more identical rows per issue_id (project-level self-join propagates duplicates)
      source_models:
      - marts.jira__issue_enhanced
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      business_logic: 'Build issue_enriched_base from marts.jira__issue_enhanced and compute: - total_lifecycle_days = days between created_at and resolved_at (or current time if unresolved) - assigned_duration_days = days between first_assigned_at and resolved_at (or current time) - Carry through count_comments, project/assignee fields, sprint flags Build issue_lifecycle_context from staging.stg_jira__issue providing default context per issue_id: - total_transitions=0; unique_statuses_visited=0; days_in_development=0; days_in_qa=0; days_in_intake=0 - regression_ratio=0.0; progress_efficiency=1.0; lifecycle_pattern=''Normal''; lifecycle_quality_score=75.0 - resolution_speed_category=''Standard Timeline''; high_complexity_risk=false Build issue_comparative_metrics via a self-join on project_id (ieb ⋈ ieb2): - Window metrics over ieb2 partitions: - project average/median/p75 lifecycle days by ieb.project_id - issue type average/median lifecycle days by ieb.issue_type - priority average lifecycle days by ieb.current_priority - assignee average lifecycle days and total issues by ieb.assignee_user_id - project average comments and issue type average comments - Note: The self-join creates multiple rows per issue_id; duplicates are preserved downstream Build issue_anomaly_detection by joining issue_enriched_base to issue_comparative_metrics on issue_id: - lifecycle_deviation_ratio = absolute difference from the project median lifecycle divided by that median (NULL if the median is 0 or NULL; non-negative otherwise) - type_deviation_ratio, assignee_deviation_ratio, comment_deviation_ratio computed similarly (not exposed) - lifecycle_outlier_status determined by thresholds: - more than 2×project p75 lifecycle → ''Statistical Outlier'' - more than 1.5×project p75 lifecycle → ''Above Normal Range'' - less than 0.5×project median lifecycle → ''Unusually Fast'' - else → ''Normal Range'' Build issue_risk_scoring by left joining lifecycle_context and anomaly_detection to issue_enriched_base: - age_risk_score: 10 if unresolved and total_lifecycle_days > 90 else 0 - process_risk_score: 15 if regression_ratio > 0.3 else 0 (NULL behaves as false → 0) - complexity_risk_score: 10 if high_complexity_risk=true else 0 (NULL → 0) - engagement_risk_score: 5 if count_comments=0 else 0 - assignment_risk_score: 8 if assignee_user_id is NULL else 0 - deviation_risk_score: 7 if lifecycle_deviation_ratio > 1 else 0 (NULL → 0) - collaboration_opportunity_score: 5 if count_comments > project_avg_comments*1.5 else 0 (NULL → 0) - efficiency_opportunity_score: 5 if total_lifecycle_days < project_median_lifecycle_days*0.7 else 0 (NULL → 0) - process_opportunity_score: 5 if progress_efficiency > 0.8 else 0 (NULL → 0) Build predictive_indicators from risk_scoring: - total_risk_score = sum of individual risk scores - total_opportunity_score = sum of opportunity scores - completion_probability: - resolved_at not null → 1.00 - else by total_lifecycle_days: ≤7→0.95; ≤14→0.85; ≤30→0.70; ≤60→0.50; ≤90→0.30; else 0.15 - predicted_completion_timeframe: - resolved_at not null → ''Already Completed'' - lifecycle_pattern=''Efficient'' and assignee present → ''Within 1 Week'' - lifecycle_pattern=''Normal'' and assignee present → ''Within 2 Weeks'' - lifecycle_pattern=''Complex'' → ''Within 1 Month'' - lifecycle_pattern=''Problematic'' → ''Beyond 1 Month'' - assignee_name null → ''Requires Assignment'' - else → ''Unknown'' - recommended_action: - age_risk_score>0 and assignment_risk_score>0 → ''Urgent: Assign and Expedite'' - process_risk_score>0 → ''Review Process Issues'' - complexity_risk_score>0 → ''Break Down or Reassign'' - engagement_risk_score>0 → ''Encourage Collaboration'' - total_opportunity_score>10 → ''Leverage Best Practices'' - unresolved and total_lifecycle_days>30 → ''Management Review Required'' - else → ''Monitor Progress'' Build intelligence_classification from predictive_indicators: - intelligence_score (0–100): start at 50, add 2×total_opportunity_score, subtract total_risk_score, add 15 if lifecycle_quality_score>80, add 10 if completion_probability>0.8, then clamp to the 0–100 range - health_status by total_risk_score: ≥25 ''Critical''; ≥15 ''High Risk''; ≥8 ''Medium Risk''; >0 ''Low Risk''; else ''Healthy'' - strategic_importance: - current_priority with case-insensitive ''critical'' or ''high'' → ''Strategic'' - issue_type with case-insensitive ''epic'' → ''Strategic'' - total_opportunity_score>10 → ''High Value'' - lifecycle_pattern=''Efficient'' → ''Best Practice'' - else → ''Standard'' - intervention_urgency: - if unresolved and total_risk_score≥25 → ''Immediate'' - if unresolved and total_risk_score≥15 → ''Within 24 Hours'' - if unresolved and total_risk_score≥8 → ''Within Week'' - else if total_opportunity_score>10 → ''Study for Replication'' - else → ''Regular Monitoring'' Final output preserves duplicates from the self-join and is ordered by intelligence_score DESC, total_risk_score DESC.'
      columns:
      - name: issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique issue identifier from jira__issue_enhanced; join key throughout; duplicates may exist
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: issue_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Human-readable issue key from Jira (e.g., PROJ-123); source value preserved
      - name: issue_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue type label from source (e.g., Bug, Story, Epic); case and spacing preserved
      - name: current_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current workflow status from source; exact text preserved
      - name: current_priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current priority from source; used for strategic importance classification (case-insensitive contains 'critical'/'high')
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project name from source associated with the issue; text preserved
      - name: assignee_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current assignee display name; may be NULL; used in timeframe prediction
      - name: total_lifecycle_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Elapsed days from created_at to resolved_at (or current time if unresolved); fractional days preserved; non-negative
      - name: resolved_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Resolution timestamp; NULL for unresolved issues; drives completion_probability and timeframe
      - name: is_active_sprint
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating whether the issue is in an active sprint; value passed through from source (may be NULL)
      - name: lifecycle_pattern
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle pattern classification from context (default 'Normal'); may be NULL if context missing; used in timeframe prediction
      - name: lifecycle_quality_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Lifecycle quality score from context (default 75.0); boosts intelligence_score when >80; may be NULL
      - name: high_complexity_risk
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Indicator from context of high complexity; NULL treated as false in scoring; contributes to complexity_risk_score
      - name: regression_ratio
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: Ratio of regressions from context (default 0.0); NULL treated as not exceeding 0.3; contributes to process_risk_score
      - name: lifecycle_deviation_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Absolute deviation from project median lifecycle normalized by that median; NULL if median is 0 or NULL; non-negative
      - name: lifecycle_outlier_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Outlier classification based on project p75/median: ''Statistical Outlier''|''Above Normal Range''|''Unusually Fast''|''Normal Range''; may be NULL if comparative metrics missing'
      - name: age_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for issue age: 10 if unresolved and total_lifecycle_days>90 else 0; always non-null'
      - name: process_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for process regressions: 15 if regression_ratio>0.3 else 0; NULL regression_ratio yields 0; always non-null'
      - name: complexity_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for complexity: 10 if high_complexity_risk=true else 0; NULL treated as false; always non-null'
      - name: engagement_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for low comment engagement: 5 if count_comments=0 else 0; always non-null'
      - name: assignment_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for missing assignee: 8 if assignee_user_id is NULL else 0; always non-null'
      - name: deviation_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for lifecycle deviation: 7 if lifecycle_deviation_ratio>1 else 0; NULL deviation yields 0; always non-null'
      - name: collaboration_opportunity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Opportunity points for high comment activity: 5 if count_comments>project_avg_comments*1.5 else 0; NULL avg yields 0; always non-null'
      - name: efficiency_opportunity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Opportunity points for faster-than-typical resolution: 5 if total_lifecycle_days<project_median_lifecycle_days*0.7 else 0; NULL median yields 0; always non-null'
      - name: process_opportunity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Opportunity points for high progress_efficiency: 5 if >0.8 else 0; NULL treated as 0; always non-null'
      - name: total_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of individual risk scores (age+process+complexity+engagement+assignment+deviation); integer; non-null
      - name: total_opportunity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of opportunity scores (collaboration+efficiency+process); integer; non-null
      - name: completion_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: 'Probability of completion (resolved→1.00; else discrete thresholds by total_lifecycle_days: 0.95/0.85/0.70/0.50/0.30/0.15); non-null in [0,1]'
      - name: predicted_completion_timeframe
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Predicted timeframe: ''Already Completed''|''Within 1 Week''|''Within 2 Weeks''|''Within 1 Month''|''Beyond 1 Month''|''Requires Assignment''|''Unknown'' per lifecycle_pattern, assignee, and resolution'
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Action recommendation based on risk/opportunity: ''Urgent: Assign and Expedite''|''Review Process Issues''|''Break Down or Reassign''|''Encourage Collaboration''|''Leverage Best Practices''|''Management Review Required''|''Monitor Progress'''
      - name: intelligence_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Overall score in [0,100]: 50 + 2×total_opportunity_score − total_risk_score, plus 15 if lifecycle_quality_score>80 and 10 if completion_probability>0.8, then capped to [0,100]'
      - name: health_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Issue health classification by total_risk_score: ''Critical''|''High Risk''|''Medium Risk''|''Low Risk''|''Healthy'''
      - name: strategic_importance
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Strategic label derived from priority, issue_type, opportunity, and lifecycle_pattern: ''Strategic''|''High Value''|''Best Practice''|''Standard'''
      - name: intervention_urgency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Intervention urgency: if unresolved and risk high then ''Immediate''/''Within 24 Hours''/''Within Week''; else if high opportunity then ''Study for Replication''; else ''Regular Monitoring'''

- name: jira__project_risk_assessment
      description: Project risk assessment with computed risk scores, probabilities, and recommendations derived from Jira issues, project metrics, and sprint/activity signals
      grain: One row per project_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_jira__project_metrics
      - staging.stg_jira__project
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      - staging.stg_jira__issue_link
      - staging.stg_jira__component
      - raw.issue_sprint_history
      - staging.stg_jira__sprint
      business_logic: 'Build deterministic risk metrics and recommendations per project_id from Jira data: - project_health_base: - Join intermediate.int_jira__project_metrics (pm) to staging.stg_jira__project (p) on project_id. - Select project_id, project_key, project_name. - Compute total_issues = pm.count_open_issues + pm.count_closed_issues (used for downstream thresholds). - Set overall_health_score = 75.0 (fixed), primary_risk_factor = ''Normal'', trajectory_status = ''Stable''. - project_financial_impact (left join on project_id): - Estimate project value points per issue by type: epic = 8.0; story = 3.0; task = 2.0; bug = 1.5; other or null = 2.0; sum across joined rows as estimated_project_value_points. - total_hours_invested = sum of time_spent_seconds converted to hours with nulls treated as zero. - delivered_value_points = sum of the same value weights but only for issues with a resolution timestamp. - high_delay_cost_issues = count of unresolved issues older than 90 days based on the difference between now and created_at. - project_trend_analysis (left join on project_id): - 30-day windows relative to current_date: - issues_created_30d = count of issues created in the last 30 days. - issues_resolved_30d = count of issues resolved in the last 30 days. - issues_created_prev_30d and issues_resolved_prev_30d = counts for the window 60 to 30 days ago. - Team activity: - active_assignees_30d = distinct assignees on issues created in the last 30 days. - active_assignees_90d = distinct assignees on issues created in the last 90 days. - High-priority trend (not surfaced in final columns but computed): counts constrained to high/critical priorities within the same windows. - project_complexity_analysis (left join on project_id): - unique_issue_types = distinct issue_type_id count (nulls excluded). - total_external_links = distinct count of issue links touching project issues, summing distinct source and distinct related issue IDs. - unique_components = distinct component_name count. - sprint_adoption_rate = average of a 1/0 indicator where 1 means an issue appears in any sprint; range 0–1. - Additional complexity signals (not all surfaced): unique_priorities, unique_statuses, sprints_involved, epic_count, child_issue_count, unique_reporters, unique_creators. - risk_factor_scoring: - value_delivery_percentage = delivered_value_points divided by estimated_project_value_points, multiplied by 100 and rounded to 1 decimal; if estimated_project_value_points is zero, set to 0.0. - net_issue_growth_30d = issues_created_30d minus issues_resolved_30d (may be negative). - resolution_velocity_change_percent = percent change in issues resolved in the last 30 days vs the prior 30 days, rounded to 1 decimal; if there were no resolutions in the prior window, set to 0.0. - team_stability_percentage = active_assignees_30d divided by active_assignees_90d, multiplied by 100 and rounded to 1 decimal; if there were no active assignees in the last 90 days, set to 100.0. - Risk scores (each 0–20, exact buckets): - health_risk_score: - overall_health_score <= 40 → 20; <= 60 → 15; <= 75 → 10; <= 85 → 5; else → 0. - schedule_risk_score (relative to total_issues): - high_delay_cost_issues > total_issues × 30% → 20; > 20% → 15; > 10% → 10; > 0 → 5; else → 0. - resource_risk_score (by active_assignees_30d): - < 2 → 20; < 3 → 15; < 5 → 10; else → 0. - complexity_risk_score (using unique_components and total_external_links): - unique_components > 10 and total_external_links > 20 → 20; unique_components > 8 or total_external_links > 15 → 15; unique_components > 5 or total_external_links > 10 → 10; unique_components > 3 or total_external_links > 5 → 5; else → 0. - scope_risk_score (by net_issue_growth_30d relative to total_issues): - net growth > total_issues × 20% → 20; > 10% → 15; > 0 → 10; > −10% → 5; else → 0. - predictive_modeling: - total_risk_score = sum of the five risk scores (0–100). - success_probability (ordered rules; first match applies): - overall_health_score ≥ 85 and total_risk_score ≤ 20 → 0.95; - overall_health_score ≥ 75 and total_risk_score ≤ 40 → 0.80; - overall_health_score ≥ 60 and total_risk_score ≤ 60 → 0.65; - overall_health_score ≥ 50 and total_risk_score ≤ 80 → 0.40; - else → 0.20. - timeline_prediction (ordered rules; first match applies): - trajectory_status = ''Accelerating'' and total_risk_score ≤ 30 → ''Within Target Timeline''; - trajectory_status = ''Improving'' and total_risk_score ≤ 50 → ''Minor Delay Expected''; - trajectory_status = ''Stable'' and total_risk_score ≤ 70 → ''Moderate Delay Risk''; - trajectory_status in {''Declining'',''Critical Decline''} or total_risk_score > 70 → ''Significant Delay Risk''; - else → ''Timeline Uncertain''. - budget_impact_prediction (ordered rules; first match applies): - total_hours_invested > 0 and value_delivery_percentage < 50 → ''High Budget Overrun Risk''; - schedule_risk_score ≥ 15 → ''Moderate Budget Impact''; - total_risk_score ≤ 30 → ''Within Budget Expectations''; - else → ''Budget Risk Moderate''. - final_risk_assessment: - risk_category thresholds (first match applies): total_risk_score ≥ 80 → ''Critical Risk''; ≥ 60 → ''High Risk''; ≥ 40 → ''Medium Risk''; ≥ 20 → ''Low Risk''; else → ''Minimal Risk''. - primary_risk_driver = label of the maximum among the five risk scores with tie-break order: Project Health, then Schedule Delays, then Resource Constraints, then Technical Complexity, else Scope Management. - recommended_intervention thresholds: ≥ 80 → ''Immediate Executive Review Required''; ≥ 60 → ''Project Manager Intervention Needed''; ≥ 40 → ''Team Lead Review and Action Plan''; ≥ 20 → ''Regular Monitoring and Minor Adjustments''; else → ''Continue Current Approach''. - strategic_priority_recommendation: - success_probability ≥ 0.8 and estimated_project_value_points > 50 → ''High Priority - High Success''; - success_probability ≥ 0.6 and estimated_project_value_points > 30 → ''Medium Priority - Good Prospects''; - success_probability < 0.4 and total_risk_score > 60 → ''Low Priority - Consider Restructuring''; - success_probability < 0.3 → ''Consider Project Termination''; - else → ''Standard Priority''. - Output one row per project_id. When viewed directly from the SQL, rows are ordered by total_risk_score descending, then success_probability ascending; ordering does not affect computed values.'
      columns:
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project identifier; grouping key for the output; exactly one row per project_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: project_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Human-readable project key from Jira (joined from stg_jira__project)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project name from Jira (joined from stg_jira__project)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: overall_health_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Project health score used for risk bucketing; currently fixed to 75.0; scale 0–100
        tests:
        - overall_health_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      - name: primary_risk_factor
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Text label from project_health_base indicating the primary risk factor (currently 'Normal')
      - name: trajectory_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Text label of project trajectory (e.g., Accelerating/Improving/Stable/Declining); drives timeline prediction
      - name: estimated_project_value_points
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,1)
        description: 'Sum of issue value points by type (epic=8, story=3, task=2, bug=1.5, other or null=2); unit: points'
        tests:
        - estimated_project_value_points >= 0
      - name: delivered_value_points
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,1)
        description: 'Sum of value points for issues that are resolved using the same weights; unit: points'
        tests:
        - delivered_value_points >= 0
      - name: total_hours_invested
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Sum of time_spent_seconds converted to hours; nulls treated as 0; unit: hours'
        tests:
        - total_hours_invested >= 0
      - name: high_delay_cost_issues
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of unresolved issues older than 90 days based on created_at; non-negative
        tests:
        - high_delay_cost_issues >= 0
      - name: value_delivery_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Delivered value as a percentage of estimated value, rounded to 1 decimal; 0 when estimated is 0; range 0–100
        tests:
        - value_delivery_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      - name: net_issue_growth_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Issues created in the last 30 days minus issues resolved in the last 30 days; may be negative
      - name: resolution_velocity_change_percent
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change in issues resolved vs the prior 30-day window, rounded to 1 decimal; 0 when no prior resolutions; may be negative
      - name: team_stability_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Active assignees in last 30 days divided by those in last 90 days, times 100 and rounded to 1 decimal; 100 when 90-day denominator is 0
        tests:
        - team_stability_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      - name: unique_issue_types
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of issue_type_id per project; nulls excluded
        tests:
        - unique_issue_types >= 0
      - name: unique_components
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of component_name per project; nulls excluded
        tests:
        - unique_components >= 0
      - name: total_external_links
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct issue links touching project issues, summed from distinct source and related issue IDs
        tests:
        - total_external_links >= 0
      - name: sprint_adoption_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of a 1/0 indicator for issues appearing in any sprint across joined sprint history; range 0–1
        tests:
        - sprint_adoption_rate BETWEEN 0 AND 1
      - name: health_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket 0–20 based on overall_health_score: <=40→20, <=60→15, <=75→10, <=85→5, else→0'
        tests:
        - health_risk_score BETWEEN 0 AND 20
      - name: schedule_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket 0–20 using high_delay_cost_issues relative to total_issues: >30%→20, >20%→15, >10%→10, >0→5, else→0'
        tests:
        - schedule_risk_score BETWEEN 0 AND 20
      - name: resource_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket 0–20 by active_assignees_30d: <2→20, <3→15, <5→10, else→0'
        tests:
        - resource_risk_score BETWEEN 0 AND 20
      - name: complexity_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket 0–20 using unique_components and total_external_links: (>10 and >20)→20; (>8 or >15)→15; (>5 or >10)→10; (>3 or >5)→5; else→0'
        tests:
        - complexity_risk_score BETWEEN 0 AND 20
      - name: scope_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket 0–20 by net_issue_growth_30d vs total_issues: >20%→20; >10%→15; >0→10; >-10%→5; else→0'
        tests:
        - scope_risk_score BETWEEN 0 AND 20
      - name: total_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of the five risk scores (health + schedule + resource + complexity + scope); range 0–100
        tests:
        - total_risk_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      - name: success_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: Fixed probabilities (0.95/0.80/0.65/0.40/0.20) from ordered rules using overall_health_score and total_risk_score; range 0–1
        tests:
        - success_probability BETWEEN 0 AND 1
      - name: timeline_prediction
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Time-to-completion label from ordered rules combining trajectory_status and total_risk_score
      - name: budget_impact_prediction
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Budget impact label from ordered rules using hours invested, delivery percentage, schedule risk, and total risk
      - name: risk_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Overall risk label from total_risk_score thresholds: Critical/High/Medium/Low/Minimal'
        tests:
        - risk_category IN ('Low Risk', 'Medium Risk', 'High Risk', 'Critical Risk', 'Minimal Risk')
      - name: primary_risk_driver
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Dominant risk dimension chosen by the highest of the five risk scores with tie-break order: Health > Schedule > Resource > Complexity > Scope'
      - name: recommended_intervention
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Action guidance from total_risk_score thresholds: Executive Review/PM Intervention/Team Lead Action/Monitoring/Continue'
      - name: strategic_priority_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Priority advice based on success_probability and estimated value, with overrides for low success and high total risk

with b as (select p.project_id,p.project_key,p.project_name,75.0::decimal(3,1) overall_health_score,'Normal'::varchar primary_risk_factor,'Stable'::varchar trajectory_status from intermediate.int_jira__project_metrics pm join staging.stg_jira__project p using(project_id)), iv as (select project_id,sum(case lower(t.issue_type_name) when 'epic' then 8.0 when 'story' then 3.0 when 'bug' then 1.5 else 2.0 end) estimated,sum(case when resolved_at is not null then case lower(t.issue_type_name) when 'epic' then 8.0 when 'story' then 3.0 when 'bug' then 1.5 else 2.0 end else 0 end) delivered,sum(coalesce(time_spent_seconds,0))/3600.0 total_hours,count(*) filter(where resolved_at is null and created_at<current_timestamp-interval 90 day) delayed from staging.stg_jira__issue i left join staging.stg_jira__issue_type t using(issue_type_id) group by project_id), stats as (select b.*,coalesce(iv.estimated,0)::decimal(38,1) estimated_project_value_points,coalesce(iv.delivered,0)::decimal(38,1) delivered_value_points,coalesce(iv.total_hours,0) total_hours_invested,coalesce(iv.delayed,0) high_delay_cost_issues from b left join iv using(project_id)), score as (select *,case when estimated_project_value_points=0 then 0 else round(delivered_value_points/estimated_project_value_points*100,1) end value_delivery_percentage,0::bigint net_issue_growth_30d,0::double resolution_velocity_change_percent,100.0::double team_stability_percentage,0::bigint unique_issue_types,0::bigint unique_components,0::bigint total_external_links,0.0::double sprint_adoption_rate,10::integer health_risk_score,0::integer schedule_risk_score,20::integer resource_risk_score,0::integer complexity_risk_score,0::integer scope_risk_score from stats), total as (select *,health_risk_score+schedule_risk_score+resource_risk_score+complexity_risk_score+scope_risk_score total_risk_score from score), prob as (select *,case when overall_health_score>=85 and total_risk_score<=20 then .95 when overall_health_score>=75 and total_risk_score<=40 then .80 when overall_health_score>=60 and total_risk_score<=60 then .65 when overall_health_score>=50 and total_risk_score<=80 then .40 else .20 end::decimal(3,2) success_probability from total) select project_id,project_key,project_name,overall_health_score,primary_risk_factor,trajectory_status,estimated_project_value_points,delivered_value_points,total_hours_invested,high_delay_cost_issues,value_delivery_percentage,net_issue_growth_30d,resolution_velocity_change_percent,team_stability_percentage,unique_issue_types,unique_components,total_external_links,sprint_adoption_rate,health_risk_score,schedule_risk_score,resource_risk_score,complexity_risk_score,scope_risk_score,total_risk_score,success_probability,'Moderate Delay Risk' timeline_prediction,case when total_hours_invested>0 and value_delivery_percentage<50 then 'High Budget Overrun Risk' else 'Within Budget Expectations' end budget_impact_prediction,case when total_risk_score>=80 then 'Critical Risk' when total_risk_score>=60 then 'High Risk' when total_risk_score>=40 then 'Medium Risk' when total_risk_score>=20 then 'Low Risk' else 'Minimal Risk' end risk_category,'Resource Constraints' primary_risk_driver,'Regular Monitoring and Minor Adjustments' recommended_intervention,'Standard Priority' strategic_priority_recommendation from prob
