- name: jira__sprint_enhanced
      description: Enhanced sprint metrics aggregated from daily sprint issue history
      grain: One row per sprint_id
      source_models:
      - marts.jira__daily_sprint_issue_history
      business_logic: 'Build sprint-level metrics from marts.jira__daily_sprint_issue_history: - Sprint metadata: Keep distinct combinations of sprint_id, sprint_name, sprint_started_at, sprint_ended_at, sprint_completed_at, board_id, original_estimate_seconds, remaining_estimate_seconds, and time_spent_seconds. - Sprint issue metrics (evaluated across all daily rows for the sprint_id): - sprint_issues: count distinct issue_id across all days. - sprint_assignees: count distinct assignee_user_id across all days (NULL user_ids are not counted). - open_sprint_issues: count distinct issues that are marked as sprint-active and open on any recorded day. - resolved_sprint_issues: count distinct issues whose resolution timestamp is on or before the sprint end and for which there is at least one daily record on or after the resolution date (distinct prevents multi-day double counting). - Commit-at-start metrics (snapshot at sprint start, or today''s snapshot for future-start sprints): - Filter rows where date_day equals the sprint start date, or where date_day equals today and the sprint start date is in the future. - story_points_committed and story_point_estimate_committed: sum values with per-row NULL treated as 0. - issues_committed: count distinct issue_id in the filtered set. - If no rows match this filter for a sprint_id, these fields are NULL after the LEFT JOIN. - End-of-sprint metrics (snapshot on the sprint end date): - Filter rows where date_day equals the sprint end date. - story_points_end and story_point_estimate_end: sum values with per-row NULL treated as 0. - story_points_completed and story_point_estimate_completed: sum values only for rows where the issue is marked resolved-in-sprint; NULL values are ignored by the SUM; if the end snapshot exists but none qualify, the sum is 0; if no end snapshot exists, the value is NULL. - Final assembly: - LEFT JOIN the issue, start, and end metrics to the metadata by sprint_id. - For original_estimate_seconds, remaining_estimate_seconds, and time_spent_seconds, sum across all distinct metadata rows for each sprint_id, treating NULL as 0; other selected fields are carried through to produce one row per sprint_id.'

- name: jira__stakeholder_engagement_insights
      description: Stakeholder engagement analysis with interaction network metrics, scorecards, and strategic recommendations (one row per active Jira user)
      grain: One row per active stakeholder_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_jira__user
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      - staging.stg_jira__comment
      - staging.stg_jira__project
      - intermediate.int_jira__issue_join
      business_logic: 'Build base activity for each active user (is_active = true): - Reporter metrics: unique issues reported and unique projects reported to; average lifecycle in days from creation to resolution, using current time for unresolved issues. - Assignee metrics: unique issues assigned and unique projects assigned to; average resolution time in days, using current time for unresolved issues. - Comment metrics: total comments authored; average comment length over authored comments. - Total projects involved: unique projects seen across the user’s reported or assigned issues (null projects excluded). Construct interaction network between commenters on the same issue: - Pair comments by different authors where the partner’s comment occurs on or after the author’s comment and within 7 days. - Aggregate per author–partner pair: unique issues discussed together; total interaction instances; average response time in hours (absolute time gap); average combined comment length; count of same-calendar-day interactions. - Compute interaction strength as interaction count, upweighted for broad discussions (>10 distinct issues) and for faster average responses (<24 hours). - Keep only pairs with at least 3 interaction instances. Compute stakeholder influence metrics by joining users to the interaction network: - Outbound (user as author): direct network connections (unique partners), average outbound interaction strength, and total outbound interaction strength. - Inbound (user as partner): total inbound interaction strength. - Cross-functional projects: unique projects tied to any issue the user reported or was assigned (nulls excluded). - Response pattern from average assigned resolution days: Rapid (≤7), Timely (≤14), Standard (≤30), else Slow; if no value, treat as Slow. Score engagement (each capped at 25): - Breadth: 3 points per project involved + 5 points per cross-functional project + up to 10 points for direct connections (maximum 25). - Depth: communication component (15 points if >100 comments, else comments ÷ 7) plus influence component (10 points if average outbound strength >50, else average outbound strength ÷ 5); capped at 25; if average outbound strength is null, depth is null. - Quality: responder class points (Rapid 15; Timely 10; Standard 5; Slow 0) plus 10 points if average outbound strength >30; capped at 25. - Impact: outbound influence tier (>500: 15; >200: 10; >50: 5; else 0) plus workload tier by issues assigned (>50: 10; >20: 7; >5: 3; else 0); capped at 25. Behavioral patterns and classifications: - Total engagement score = breadth + depth + quality + impact (0–100 when depth is present; null if depth is null). - Stakeholder archetype (first match): Power Collaborator (breadth ≥20 and depth ≥15); Quality Influencer (quality ≥20 and impact ≥15); Cross-Functional Coordinator (breadth ≥15 and projects involved ≥5); Deep Specialist (depth ≥20); High Impact Contributor (impact ≥20); Active Communicator (comments >100); Heavy Executor (issues assigned >20); Requirements Driver (issues reported >20); Network Hub (connections >10); else Standard Participant. - Influence level (first match): High (outbound influence >500 and connections >15); Medium (outbound influence >200 and connections >8); Low (outbound influence >50 or connections >3); else Minimal. - Engagement risk (first match): Disengagement Risk (total engagement <20); Delivery Risk (Slow responder and issues assigned >10); Overwhelm Risk (inbound influence more than double outbound); Isolation Risk (connections <2 and projects involved >1); else Healthy Engagement. Strategic insights: - Strategic value score (first match): 100 (Power Collaborator or Quality Influencer with High Influence); 85 (Cross-Functional Coordinator or High Impact Contributor with High/Medium Influence); 70 (Deep Specialist or Network Hub); 75 (High Influence); 60 (total engagement ≥70); 45 (≥50); else 30. - Recommended strategy (first match): Re-engagement Campaign; Performance Support; Workload Optimization; Network Integration; Leverage and Amplify (Power Collaborator); Strategic Partnering (Quality Influencer); Key Relationship Management (High Influence); else Standard Engagement. - Development opportunity (first match): Cross-Project Exposure (breadth <10 and depth ≥15); Communication Effectiveness Training (quality <10 and comments >50); Leadership Development (impact <10 and issues assigned >20); Network Building (connections <3); Cross-Functional Assignment (no cross-functional projects); else Advanced Leadership Opportunities. Final output: one row per active stakeholder_id with all fields above; rows are ordered by strategic value score descending, then total engagement score descending.'
      columns:
      - name: stakeholder_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Active user_id serving as the stakeholder key; exactly one output row per stakeholder_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: user_display_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name for the stakeholder from the user source
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: issues_reported
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique issues the stakeholder reported; null issue_ids excluded; returns 0 if none
      - name: issues_assigned
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique issues assigned to the stakeholder; null issue_ids excluded; returns 0 if none
      - name: total_comments_authored
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total comments authored by the stakeholder; returns 0 if none
      - name: total_projects_involved
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique projects seen across the stakeholder’s reported or assigned issues; null projects excluded; returns 0 if none
      - name: direct_network_connections
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique interaction partners from the filtered network (only pairs with at least 3 interactions); returns 0 if none
      - name: response_pattern_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Assignee resolution speed class: Rapid (≤7d), Timely (≤14d), Standard (≤30d), else Slow; null values treated as Slow'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: avg_outbound_influence_strength
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average interaction strength across outbound connections; excludes nulls; null if no outbound interactions
      - name: total_outbound_influence
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Total interaction strength across outbound connections; null if no outbound interactions
      - name: total_inbound_influence
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Total interaction strength across inbound connections (where the stakeholder is the partner); null if no inbound interactions
      - name: cross_functional_projects
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique projects for issues where the stakeholder is reporter or assignee; null projects excluded; returns 0 if none
      - name: engagement_breadth_score
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 0–25, calculated as 3 points per project involved + 5 per cross-functional project + up to 10 for direct connections; capped at 25; never null
      - name: engagement_depth_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 0–25, sum of a communication component (15 if comments >100 else comments ÷ 7) and an influence component (10 if avg strength >50 else avg strength ÷ 5); capped at 25; null if average outbound strength is null
      - name: engagement_quality_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25, responder class points (Rapid 15, Timely 10, Standard 5, Slow 0) plus 10 if average outbound strength >30; capped at 25; never null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: engagement_impact_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25, sum of outbound influence tier (>500:15, >200:10, >50:5, else 0) and issues-assigned tier (>50:10, >20:7, >5:3, else 0); capped at 25; never null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_engagement_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of breadth, depth, quality, and impact (0–100 when depth is present); null if engagement_depth_score is null
      - name: stakeholder_archetype
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Ordered classification: Power Collaborator, Quality Influencer, Cross-Functional Coordinator, Deep Specialist, High Impact Contributor, Active Communicator, Heavy Executor, Requirements Driver, Network Hub, else Standard Participant'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: influence_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Ordered tiers: High (outbound >500 and connections >15), Medium (outbound >200 and connections >8), Low (outbound >50 or connections >3), else Minimal'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: strategic_value_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Ordered mapping: 100 for Power Collaborator or Quality Influencer with High Influence; 85 for Cross-Functional Coordinator or High Impact Contributor with High/Medium Influence; 70 for Deep Specialist or Network Hub; 75 for High Influence; 60 if total engagement ≥70; 45 if ≥50; else 30'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: engagement_risk_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Ordered risks: Disengagement (<20 total engagement), Delivery (Slow responder and issues assigned >10), Overwhelm (inbound > 2× outbound), Isolation (connections <2 and projects involved >1), else Healthy'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: recommended_engagement_strategy
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Ordered strategies: Re-engagement Campaign, Performance Support, Workload Optimization, Network Integration, Leverage and Amplify, Strategic Partnering, Key Relationship Management, else Standard Engagement'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: development_opportunity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Ordered opportunities: Cross-Project Exposure, Communication Effectiveness Training, Leadership Development, Network Building, Cross-Functional Assignment, else Advanced Leadership Opportunities'
        tests:
        - not_null

- name: jira__team_performance_dashboard
      description: Team performance dashboard per user aggregated across all projects with activity, delivery, collaboration, growth, risk, and scoring metrics
      grain: One row per user_id (project_id='all_projects')
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_jira__user_metrics
      - staging.stg_jira__user
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      - staging.stg_jira__issue_link
      - staging.stg_jira__comment
      - staging.stg_jira__sprint
      - staging.stg_jira__issue_field_history
      - staging.stg_jira__field
      - raw.issue_sprint_history
      business_logic: '- Build user_activity_summary: - Join user metrics to users on user_id; emit one row per user with project_id=''all_projects'' and project_name=''All Projects''. - Set current_engagement_tier=''Standard User'', current_pattern_type=''Regular User'', current_lifecycle_stage=''Stable''. - Set avg_daily_activity_score and avg_weekly_activity_score from average close time days; avg_consistency_score=0.7; last_active_date=current_date; active_days_count=30; churn_risk_days=0; productive_days=count_closed_issues; highly_active_days=count_closed_issues if >10 else 0. - Build team_collaboration_metrics from issues created in the last 90 days and with a non-null assignee: - Group by project_id and assignee_user_id. - total_assigned_issues counts assigned issues. - resolved_issues counts assigned issues with a resolution date. - avg_resolution_days averages the days between creation and resolution over resolved issues. - high_priority_issues counts assigned issues with a non-null priority. - bug_issues counts assigned issues with a non-null issue type (label is generic, not limited to “Bug”). - epic_issues counts assigned issues with a non-null parent issue. - Join issue links and count distinct linked issue references on both sides; join comments and count distinct non-assignee comment authors. - estimate_accuracy_ratio averages the absolute relative difference between time spent and original estimate over issues where both values are present and >0. - Build sprint_participation_analysis from recent sprints (started within 180 days), issues, and derived story points: - Parse numeric story points from active field history where the field name contains “story” and “point”; default to 1 when no number is found. - Group by sprint_id, sprint_name, assignee user_id, and project_id. - Measure issues_in_sprint, issues_completed_in_sprint (resolved within sprint window), total_story_points, story_points_completed_in_sprint, and avg_completion_day_in_sprint (days from sprint start to resolution when resolved on/before sprint end). - Build user_growth_metrics by left joining user_activity_summary to issues and comments: - Consider issues where the user is assignee, reporter, or creator; and comments authored by the user. - first_issue_date is the earliest issue creation date; last_resolved_date is the latest resolution date. - days_since_first_issue is the days from current_date to first_issue_date. - issue_types_worked_on counts distinct issue types; priority_levels_handled counts distinct priorities; projects_contributed_to counts distinct projects. - issues_reported counts issues reported by the user; issues_commented_on counts distinct issues the user commented on. - Build team_performance_scoring by left joining user_activity_summary to team_collaboration_metrics, user_growth_metrics, and aggregated sprint metrics: - Aggregate sprint metrics per user and project: sprint_count (distinct sprints), avg_sprint_completion_rate (average of per-sprint completed/issues; sprints with zero issues are excluded), total_story_points_delivered (sum of completed story points). - Rounding and units: - avg_daily_activity_score and avg_weekly_activity_score are computed to two decimals but stored without fractional part due to column type. - consistency_percentage = avg_consistency_score × 100 rounded to one decimal. - resolution_rate_percentage = percentage of assigned issues resolved, rounded to one decimal; NULL if no assigned issues. - avg_resolution_days rounded to one decimal; NULL if no resolved issues. - estimate_accuracy_percentage = estimate_accuracy_ratio × 100 rounded to one decimal; NULL if no eligible issues. - Risk flags: at_churn_risk is true when churn_risk_days > 7; inactive_recently is true when current_date − last_active_date > 7 days; poor_estimation is true when estimate accuracy ratio > 2; all flags are always populated (no NULLs). - Note: Joins to collaboration and sprint metrics use (user_id, project_id); because project_id=''all_projects'', these often remain NULL. - Final scoring and tiering: - overall_performance_score clamps to 0–100 and sums components: - Delivery (40%): 40/30/20/10/0 points at resolution rate ≥90/≥75/≥60/≥40/else. - Activity (30%): 30/20/10/0 points for engagement tier Highly/Moderately/Lightly Active/else. - Quality (20%): 20/15/10/5 points for estimate accuracy in [80,120]/[70,130]/[60,140]/else. - Collaboration (10%): 10/7/5/0 points at unique collaborators ≥5/≥3/≥1/else. - performance_tier: Top Performer (score ≥85), Strong Performer (≥70), Average Performer (≥50), else Needs Improvement. - Final output is ordered by overall_performance_score descending, then project_name, then user_display_name.'
      columns:
      - name: user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User identifier; grouping key; exactly one output row per user_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: user_display_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name from staging.stg_jira__user for the user_id
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email from staging.stg_jira__user; may be NULL if not present
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant 'all_projects' emitted for every user row
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant 'All Projects' emitted for every user row
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: current_engagement_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Engagement tier label set to 'Standard User'; used in scoring only when equal to 'Highly Active', 'Moderately Active', or 'Lightly Active'
      - name: current_pattern_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Activity pattern label; constant 'Regular User'
      - name: current_lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle stage label; constant 'Stable'
      - name: avg_daily_activity_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Derived from average close time days; computed to two decimals then stored without fractional part
      - name: avg_weekly_activity_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Derived from average close time days; computed to two decimals then stored without fractional part
      - name: consistency_percentage
        data_type: DECIMAL(12,1)
        description: Activity consistency expressed as a percentage rounded to one decimal; constant 70.0 in current logic
      - name: total_assigned_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of issues assigned to the user in the last 90 days; NULL when no (user_id, project_id) match to collaboration metrics due to project_id='all_projects'
      - name: resolved_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of assigned issues with a resolution date in the last 90 days; NULL when no (user_id, project_id) match to collaboration metrics
      - name: resolution_rate_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage of assigned issues resolved in the last 90 days, rounded to one decimal; NULL if no assigned issues
      - name: avg_resolution_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average days from issue creation to resolution for resolved issues in the last 90 days, rounded to one decimal; NULL if none
      - name: high_priority_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of assigned issues with a non-null priority in the last 90 days; NULL when no (user_id, project_id) match to collaboration metrics
      - name: performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier based on overall_performance_score: Top Performer (≥85), Strong Performer (≥70), Average Performer (≥50), else Needs Improvement'
      - name: bug_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of assigned issues with a non-null issue type in the last 90 days (generic, not limited to 'Bug'); NULL when no match
      - name: epic_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of assigned issues with a non-null parent issue in the last 90 days; NULL when no match
      - name: estimate_accuracy_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average relative deviation between time spent and original estimate over issues with both values >0, expressed as a percentage and rounded to one decimal; higher is worse; NULL if no eligible issues
      - name: linked_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total distinct linked issue references (issue_id plus related_issue_id) for the user's assigned issues in the last 90 days; NULL when no match
      - name: unique_collaborators_on_issues
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct non-assignee comment authors on the user's assigned issues in the last 90 days; NULL when no match
      - name: projects_contributed_to
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct projects across issues where the user is assignee, reporter, or creator; 0 if none
      - name: issue_types_worked_on
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct issue types across issues where the user is assignee, reporter, or creator; 0 if none
      - name: sprint_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct sprint count aggregated per (user_id, project_id); NULL when no match because project_id='all_projects'
      - name: avg_sprint_completion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average per-sprint completion ratio (completed issues divided by issues in sprint), excluding sprints with zero issues; NULL when no matching sprint data for the user and project
      - name: total_story_points_delivered
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Sum of story points completed within sprints per (user_id, project_id); NULL when no match because project_id='all_projects'
      - name: days_since_first_issue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Days between current_date and the user's first observed issue creation date; NULL if the user has no issues
      - name: leadership_indicator
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of issues reported by the user; 0 if none
      - name: at_churn_risk
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when churn_risk_days > 7; False otherwise; always populated
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: inactive_recently
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when current_date minus last_active_date exceeds 7 days; False otherwise; always populated
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: poor_estimation
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when the estimate accuracy ratio exceeds 2; False otherwise or when unavailable; always populated
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: overall_performance_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Composite score (0–100) from delivery, activity, quality, and collaboration components; clamped to 0–100 using defined thresholds
        tests:
        - not_null
